scripts.translation: 哦，原来如此...你是刚到这里的初心者吧？

scripts.text: I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation: 这确实有点出乎意料。你想学<装死>吗？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation: 我保证这技能对你有帮助。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
scripts.translation: 真的？你要是忙的话，那就算了。我

scripts.text: I want to teach you for good.
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation: 初心者往往不了解自己的潜力，也不清楚敌人有多强。

scripts.text: There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation: 有些初心者很爱钻研...不过我想我们都不是那种人。

scripts.text: And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation: 动。不过，有时也会被强敌打败...

scripts.text: Huh? You're right this is my story.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你说得没错，这说的就是我

scripts.text: I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation: 。我都快受够一次次被打败了。

scripts.text: One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation: 有一天，我灵机一动：遇到强敌时，干脆假装自己已经死了...

scripts.text: I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
scripts.translation: 因为我不擅长装死，好几次都险些丧命。现在回

scripts.text: Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation: 想起来，还是让人心惊胆战...

scripts.text: So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation: 那以后，我的装死战术就越来越管用了！

scripts.text: I could not hold a breath for a long time.
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation: 机灵的魔物会察觉到我的呼吸！

scripts.text: So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好训练自己，尽可能长时间地屏住呼吸。

scripts.text: Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation: 听起来很复杂...其实很简单。

scripts.text: If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation: 如果遇到强敌，觉得自己打不过，就倒在地上装死吧。

scripts.text: I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation: 我来简单测试一下你能不能屏住呼吸。

scripts.text: Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation: 屏住呼吸 20 秒，之后再来找我。在时间到之前来找我的话，我可不会让你通过！

scripts.text: What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
scripts.translation: 什么？你连20秒都撑不住？你得

scripts.text: You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation: 先学会屏住呼吸，才能学这招！

scripts.text: If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation: 不错。只要有这样的耐心，就能在危急时救自己一命，让魔物拿你没办法。

scripts.text: The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation: <装死>技能已加入技能列表，按<Alt + S>即可打开。遇到危险时别忘了使用，它能救你一命。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation: 等你成长并转职后，就用不上这技能了。需要时尽管用，别犹豫！

scripts.text: I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation: 我得睡一会儿，别吵醒我。哈啊...

scripts.text: I am in charge guiding you here in the Academy.
scripts.translation: 过得怎么样？我负责带你熟悉学院。

scripts.text: Welcome to our Academy. I am in charge with the guide and registration for Novice education courses.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到学院。我负责指引初心者教育课程，并为学员办理报名。

scripts.text: What can I do for you?
- As you are overloaded with too many items, quest can't be continued.-
scripts.translation: - 背包里的物品太多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: Let me see... Your name is... {0}.
I will make a new registration for you.
You can choose the course freely and each course has individual features.
scripts.translation: 记。你可以自由选择课程，每门课程都有各自的特色。

scripts.text: And this is the basic equipment for the educational course.
scripts.translation: 这是教育课程的基础装备，请好好

scripts.text: Please make a good use of it.
Be careful with it as it won't be provided again.
scripts.translation: 保管，之后不会再次发放。

scripts.text: It is your first step to be an adventurer that you have made a visit to us.
scripts.translation: 来这里拜访，就是你成为冒险者的第一步。

scripts.text: On our next meeting, I anticipate you will grow up a bit more.
scripts.translation: 希望下次见面时，你已经又成长了一些。

scripts.text: One who is not a Novice can't attend the educational course.
scripts.translation: 非初心者不能参加教育课程。

scripts.text: However, a part of the educational course except the character cultivation can be freely attended. So, you may look around the Academy and neighboring places.
scripts.translation: 不过，除了角色培养之外，其他教育课程都可以自由参加。你可以去学院和附近转转。

scripts.text: The first floor is equipped with instructors that give you lessons on how the world works here in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 一楼有指导员，会为你讲解米德加尔特的世界和基础知识。

scripts.text: First of all, at the dispensary, you can learn how to recover your physical strength and learn a skill to heal your HP
scripts.translation: 首先，在医务室可以学习如何恢复体力，以及治疗 HP 的技能。

scripts.text: At the armory, you can get simple training about battling monsters in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 在武器库可以接受基础训练，学习如何在米德加尔特与魔物战斗。

scripts.text: At the cafeteria, you can practice cooking and and will learn its many benefits.
scripts.translation: 在餐厅可以练习烹饪，并了解烹饪的各种好处。

scripts.text: At the 2nd floor, there are trainers that will teach you about the different job classes in the world.
scripts.translation: 二楼有职业导师，会为你介绍这个世界的各种职业。

scripts.text: Listen to the trainers and decide for yourself which job suits your personal style.
scripts.translation: 听听导师们的介绍，再选择最适合自己风格的职业吧。

scripts.text: This town is called 'Izlude' the satellite and port city of the Capital City of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom Prontera.
scripts.translation: 这里叫依斯鲁得，是卢恩·米德加兹王国首都普隆德拉的卫星城和港口城市。

scripts.text: This town was re-organized to suit the education of Novices.
scripts.translation: 这座城镇经过重新规划，方便初心者在此接受教育。

scripts.text: Please find me, if you need anything else.
scripts.translation: 还有其他需要的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text: Left-Click your mouse on the name of the trainer you are looking for and I will give guide you to them.
scripts.translation: 点击你想找的导师姓名，我就会为你指路。

scripts.translation: 希望下次见面时，你能变得更加出色。加油~~~

- As you are overloaded with too many items in your inventory -
scripts.translation: 下！！- 你的背包物品太多了- 已经

scripts.text: - You can't receive the items anymore -
scripts.translation: 无法再领取物品- 请先整

scripts.text: Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation: 准备好了解异常状态了吗？我保证不再捉弄你了。毕竟我可是个“导师”，对吧？

scripts.text: First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation: 首先，我来给你讲讲<中毒>。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation: 就像你刚才体验到的那样，中毒后身体会变成紫色，而且每秒都会损失少量 HP。

scripts.text: You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation: HP 不会一直减少，所以中毒不会致命。

scripts.text: Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation: 实践出真知！我现在就让你进入中毒状态。

scripts.text: See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation: 看看你处于中毒状态时会有什么反应。

scripts.text: Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation: 看清中毒状态的效果了吗？过一段时间后，毒素可能会自行消退；但如果这时还在持续受攻击，就别指望它会自然消退了。

scripts.text: Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation: 接下来，我来给你讲讲< 眩晕>。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation: 眩晕时，你的头顶会有星星打转，而且基本无法移动，完全处于“毫无防备”的状态。

scripts.text: As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
scripts.translation: 毫无防备时，你无法移动、使用技能或物

scripts.text: So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation: 品，因此没办法自行解除状态。

scripts.text: The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation: 有个例外：如果你是修罗，可以使用<点穴-快>技能解除眩晕。 ^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation: 也可以使用牧师的<恢复>或大主教的<折枝赞颂>等技能解除。 ^0022FF^000000^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation: 让我演示一下眩晕状态的效果！

scripts.text: Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
scripts.translation: 想象一下，你动弹不得时，魔物正朝你冲来...相信

scripts.text: This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation: 接下来，我要教你关于<睡眠>的知识。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation: 进入睡眠状态时，你会睡着，头上还会冒出一个<Zzz>。

scripts.text: Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation: 和眩晕时一样，你会毫无防备；不同的是，受到敌人攻击后你就会醒来。

scripts.text: But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation: 不过，睡眠状态下更容易受到敌人的暴击，处境会很危险，也可能遭受重创。

scripts.text: For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation: 提醒你一下，睡眠状态无法自行解除，只能靠牧师的<恢复>技能解除。 ^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation: 让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text: How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation: 怎么样？想象一下在危险的敌人面前睡着，不太好受吧？

scripts.text: Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation: 睡眠有助于恢复，但在激烈的战斗中可不是什么好事。

scripts.text: Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation: 最后，我来讲讲<沉默>状态。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation: 进入沉默状态后，你无法使用任何魔法技能，头顶还会出现一个<...>。

scripts.text: But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation: 不过，沉默并不会让你无法攻击，仍然可以进行普通攻击。

scripts.text: In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation: 沉默状态下，你只能进行物理攻击，或者使用药水恢复。

scripts.text: It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation: 让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text: It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation: 不能使用技能，是不是很令人着急？

scripts.text: Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation: 尤其是依赖技能而非普通攻击的高阶职业，或在战斗中陷入睡眠时，都会因此遭受重创。

scripts.text: In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation: 此外还有黑暗、冰冻、诅咒、石化、混乱等状态，我也可以让你逐一体验。

scripts.text: I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation: 希望这次体验能帮你提前熟悉今后冒险中会遇到的状况。

scripts.text: Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation: 想体验其他异常状态时，随时来找我。

scripts.text: As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation: 之前便当盒的事是我不好，就送你一份小礼物赔罪吧。

scripts.text: Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation: 你是刚来学院的新手训练生吗？

scripts.text: I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation: 我是教官美因茨，负责这所学院的教学工作。

scripts.text: It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation: ？现在还不重要，之后我再告诉你。

scripts.text: You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation: 读了这么多、学了这么多，一定很累吧？

scripts.text: Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
scripts.translation: 你需要帮助时，有个人能帮你。

scripts.text: Do you know who is it?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation: 意思？我特地为疲惫的你准备了一份礼物！
给你准备了便当！！！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
scripts.translation: 放心，不是我做的。这是我亲

scripts.text: My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation: 爱的妻子准备的。来，别客气，尽管享用！

scripts.text: You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation: 你不想要这个便当？那可就亏大了。

scripts.text: Should I just take it for myself then?
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation: 智的决定。可别忘了，我其实很想吃；不过看你这么累，才先让给你！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你打开便当盒，发现里面装着某种食物 -

scripts.text: Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈！别犹豫，快吃吧！吃

scripts.text: It will refresh you from your fatigue!
- Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 你又累又饿，只好收下便当盒 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物后，胃里突然一阵剧痛，视线也开始模糊 -

scripts.text: I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation: 我给你一剂解毒药，服下后应该会好些。
- 你不情愿地服下了解毒药 -

scripts.text: Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 对了，我听说皇家克里阿图拉学院里有幽灵出没。

scripts.text: I think the ghost must have poisoned you.
scripts.translation: 我看一定是那个幽灵给你下了毒。

scripts.text: - You roll your eyes at Mainz -
scripts.translation: - 你朝美因茨翻了个白眼

scripts.text: - Mainz turns his head as if he doesn't notice -
scripts.translation: -- 美因茨转过头，装作没看见 -

scripts.text: Please understand there is no malice.
All of these are for you...
scripts.translation: 我做这一切都是为了你好.

scripts.text: Want to know what I mean?
There are various kinds of monsters on the Midgard continent. And some of them can poison you or put you in abnormal conditions.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特大陆上有各种各样的魔物，有些会让你中毒或陷入其他异常状态。

scripts.text: Usually, anybody is too embarrassed to admit being poisoned without knowing.  I just did it on purpose to let you have the experience in case it happens out in the real world.
scripts.translation: 通常，谁也不愿承认自己不知不觉就中毒了。我故意让你体验一次，以后在真正的冒险中遇到时，你就知道该怎么办了。

scripts.text: Understand that I didn't intend to pass my wife's lunchbox as if it was a present. It was just another lesson from the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 别误会，我不是把妻子做的便当当作礼物糊弄你。这只是克里阿图拉学院安排的另一堂课。

scripts.text: As an apology, I would like to inform you of several abnormal statuses you might experience in the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 为了赔罪，我来给你介绍几种在米德加尔特大陆上可能遇到的异常状态。

scripts.text: Don't decline it! Being ready to learn so speak to me again.
scripts.translation: 别拒绝啊！准备好学习之后，再来找我聊聊吧。

scripts.text: Any questions about getting a monster to become a pet?
scripts.translation: 想知道如何把魔物驯养成宠物吗？

scripts.text: Only some monsters can become pets and they all have different things to tame them.
scripts.translation: 只有部分魔物可以成为宠物，而且每种魔物需要的驯服道具都不一样。

scripts.text: Each monster that can be tamed requires a specific ^3131FFtaming item^000000.
scripts.translation: 每种可驯服的魔物都有对应的驯服道具。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FFdouble click^000000 the taming item in your inventory and select which monster to tame.
scripts.translation: 先在背包里双击驯服道具，再选择目标魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Press ^3131FFClick^000000 in the center of the pop-up slot machine to tame the monster..
scripts.translation: 点击弹出的老虎机窗口中央的“点击”按钮，就能尝试驯服魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: If successful, the monster will be tranformed into an egg!
scripts.translation: 驯服成功后，魔物就会变成宠物蛋！

scripts.text: Hatching requires you to have a ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000 to awaken a monster in the egg.
scripts.translation: 要孵化宠物蛋，必须持有<携带用孵蛋器>，才能唤醒蛋里的魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Most towns have a ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 where you can buy the ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000.
scripts.translation: 大多数城镇都有<宠物美容师>，能在那里买到<携带用 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Ask the town guide for the location of the Pet Groomer if you can't find them.
scripts.translation: 孵蛋器>。找不到的话，可以向城镇向导打听宠物美容师的位置。

scripts.text: ^3131FFRight-click^000000 on your pet and select ^3131ffCheck the Pet Status^000000 to check on its status. Or you can press ^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000.
scripts.translation: 右键点击宠物，再选择查看宠物状态即可查看状态。也可以按<Alt+J>。 ^3131FF^000000^3131ff^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: This will open up the Status Window. Here you can change the pet's ^3131FFname^000000 as well as check their ^3131FFHunter^000000 and ^3131FFIntimacy^000000.
scripts.translation: 这样会打开状态窗口。在这里可以更改宠物的名字，查看它的饥饿度和亲密度。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: There are some special pets that gives special skills when their ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 level becomes Loyal. Most pets start off as shy and time and food changes that.

scripts.text: <Pet Food> is normal food for pets but some pets prefer other foods. You should keep enough with you so your pet doesn't get hungry.
scripts.translation: <宠物饲料>是宠物的常见食物，但有些宠物偏爱其他食物。记得随身带够食物，别让宠物饿着。

scripts.text: Pets will ^3131FFrun away^000000 if they are too full or too hungry. So make sure you check your pets hunger status frequently!
scripts.translation: 宠物太饱或太饿都会逃跑。记得经常查看宠物的饥饿度！ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Some pets will show a special performance when they are in a good mood.
scripts.translation: 有些宠物心情好时会做出特别的动作。

scripts.text: Some pets can even wear accessory items.
scripts.translation: 有些宠物还能佩戴饰品。

scripts.text: ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 will sell some pet accessory items but some monsters will also drop pet accessory items as well.
scripts.translation: <宠物美容师>会出售宠物饰品，有些魔物也会掉落。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I think it is better off experiencing more together than transforming back to the eggs?
scripts.translation: 比起把宠物变回蛋，不如继续一起冒险、创造更多回忆吧？

scripts.text: Come back again when you have another question.
scripts.translation: 还有问题的话，随时再来找我。

scripts.text: I am hungry~ Feed me first, then let's walk around~
scripts.translation: 我饿了~先喂我吃点东西，再带我出去逛逛吧~

scripts.text: Calm down now, here you go!
Phew, it was good. I'm full.
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation: 宠物是孤独旅途中最好的伙伴...

scripts.text: Once it was a dangerous monster, now it is my closest friend. This is my ^3131FFpet^000000 which is called as Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation: 它曾是危险的魔物，如今却成了我最亲密的伙伴。这就是我的宠物，名字叫黛比·鲁奇。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Yawn~ I am bored to death!
Well they're loyal ^3131FFmonster^000000s that stand by your side.
scripts.translation: 宠物是忠诚的魔物，会一直陪伴在你身边。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: It doesn't help me battle but it helps by giving me bonus ^3131FFstats^000000 and other bonus effects.
scripts.translation: 它不会帮我战斗，但能提供额外的属性和其他增益效果。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: All these things are possible when ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 with your pet is very high.
scripts.translation: 只要和宠物的亲密度足够高，就能获得这些效果。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Intimacy requires a time commitment and a lot of food. Food is the way to any being's loyalty right? ha ha
scripts.translation: 培养亲密度需要花时间，也得准备很多食物。俗话说，想收服谁的心，就先喂饱谁，对吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: How do I get a pet?
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation: 宠物是孤独旅途中最好的伙伴...

scripts.text: Hmm then let's go to the Academy Gardens together!

scripts.text: I'll show you how it's done.
Talk to me when you are ready to go to the garden!

scripts.text: Shall we go to the garden of Criatura Academy?

scripts.text: If you want, I will guide you anytime.

scripts.text: Ha ha ha, don't fret my pet.

scripts.text: Yep, it means you are ready to be a friend like me and Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation: 没错，这说明你也能像我和黛比·鲁奇一样，和宠物成为朋友了。

scripts.text: There are lots of different monsters and tames out there.

scripts.text: If you successfully tame it you end up with a little egg.

scripts.text: So congratulations again for passing the test, the friendship test!
scripts.translation: 再次恭喜你通过考验，成为宠物的朋友！

scripts.text: Ask anytime whenever you have a question about cute pets.

scripts.text: Do you see the shivering poring over there? Go easy on the lil' blighter, okay?
scripts.translation: 看到那只发抖的波利了吗？对它温柔点，别吓着它，好吗？

scripts.text: If you are confused, Please check the quest status by clicking ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.

scripts.text: Dear oh dear...what do we have 'ere?
Wot a sad state of affairs.
That geeza' ghostring got defeated out in his dungeon and came here to pick on other monsters like me.
scripts.translation: 那个混账幽灵波利在迷宫里被打败后，跑来这儿欺负我这样的魔物。

scripts.text: I'm too low level to stop 'im, you can hear them cheering now...
scripts.translation: 我的等级太低，拦不住它。你听，他们现在又在欢呼了...

scripts.text: Oi you lot! Tell me wot I want to hear!
scripts.translation: 喂，你们这群家伙！说点我爱听的！

scripts.text: Ghostring's the strongest in the world!
scripts.translation: 幽灵波利是世界上最强的！

scripts.text: What kind of monster I am?
Little Porings takin' up with a git like that and not bein' cute anymore.
scripts.translation: 宝贝波利居然跟那种混账混在一起，连可爱劲儿都没了。

scripts.text: The Little Porings aren't bad'uns, they've just not been to the outside world.
scripts.translation: 宝贝波利们其实不坏，只是它们还没去过外面的世界。

scripts.text: If this keeps up, all of the Porings in Midgard will be under the sway of Ghostring.
scripts.translation: 再这样下去，米德加尔特所有的波利都会被幽灵波利控制。

scripts.text: Now that you mention it sir, I could use some help.
scripts.translation: 你这么一说，先生，我确实需要帮忙。

scripts.text: Wot's Dat? Onna them Poring's talkin' to a huumie.
scripts.translation: 那是什么？有只波利居然在跟人类说话。我

scripts.text: What can I do to help?
I do have a good idea!
The favorite items for Little Poring to eat.
Maybe you can use it to tempt them away from listenin' to Ghostring.
scripts.translation: 也许你可以用它把宝贝波利引开，让它们不再听幽灵波利的话。

scripts.text: ^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 a ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000 that you fancy.
scripts.translation: 双击我给你的青苹果，再选择你喜欢的宝贝波利。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: TThe click the centre of the slot machine.
That'll lure them from out of Ghostring's influence.
scripts.translation: 这样就能把它们从幽灵波利的控制中引出来。

scripts.text: Ello' mate. Were you successful? Where are the lil' bleeders?
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计，成功了吗？那些小家伙在哪儿？

scripts.text: What did you do to Unskilled Poring!?!? Novice!!!!!!
scripts.translation: 你对笨拙的波利做了什么？！初心者！！！！！

scripts.text: I used the unripe apples that you gave me, then they turned into eggs.
scripts.translation: 我用了你给我的青苹果，它们就变成蛋了。

scripts.text: Oh, guess I didn't expect they'd be turned into pets so easily!
scripts.translation: 哦，没想到这么容易就能把它们变成宠物！

scripts.text: Yeah, don't worry, I'll make sure to
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 your preferred ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000.
scripts.translation: 双击我给你的青苹果，再选择你喜欢的宝贝波利。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: The all you have to do is ^3131FFclick ^0000 the middle of the slot machine.
scripts.translation: 接着只要点击老虎机中央即可。 ^3131FF

scripts.text: It may fail, but keep trying to lure way those Little Porings!
scripts.translation: 可能会失败，但继续尝试把那些宝贝波利引过来吧！

scripts.text: Have you ever heard about the changes of a novice from adept adventurer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过从初心者成长为老练冒险者的过程吗？

scripts.text: Unripe Apples are the item to tame.
scripts.translation: 青苹果是用来驯服魔物的

scripts.text: It will only work on the Little Porings hopping around.
scripts.translation: 道具。只对四处蹦跳的宝贝波利有效。

scripts.text: If you're going to make them a cute pet...
scripts.translation: 想让它们成为可爱的宠物...

scripts.text: You must take care of your Little Poring!
scripts.translation: 就得好好照顾你的宝贝波利！

scripts.text: Even before that Ghostring came here, the Little Porings were kind of cowardly.
scripts.translation: 即使在幽灵波利来这里之前，宝贝波利就已经有点胆小了。

scripts.text: Since they've never been out in the real world, sort of like human novices.
scripts.translation: 它们从没去过外面的世界，就像人类的初心者一样。

scripts.text: You're just starting out on your adventure, right? You will visit many towns and meet many people and encounter the frightful Boss Monsters.
scripts.translation: 你才刚开始冒险吧？以后会走访许多城镇、结识许多人，还会遇上可怕的头目魔物。

scripts.text: Won't you consider taking one of these chavs with you?
scripts.translation: 要不要带一只这样的可爱小家伙一起旅行？

scripts.text: They're smeggin' talkative, but they'll be loyal friends!
scripts.translation: 它们虽然话很多，却会是忠实的伙伴！

scripts.text: I'd say that the ^31311FAdept adventurer ^000000knows lots of things about pets, so you can ask him about your new Little Poring Friend.
scripts.translation: 我想，老练的冒险者很了解宠物。你的新伙伴宝贝波利有什么问题，都可以去问他。 ^31311F^000000

scripts.text: By the way, you should have a ^3131FFportable egg incubator ^000000.
scripts.translation: 对了，你应该有一个<携带用孵蛋器> ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: It was dropped by a careless ^3131FFPet Groomer^000000 traveling through.
scripts.translation: 。这是一个路过的粗心宠物美容师掉下的。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I will also give you the Little Poring's favorite ^3131FFapple juice^000000, so make sure that it stays fed all the time!
scripts.translation: 我还会送你宝贝波利最爱喝的苹果汁，记得按时喂它！ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I look forward to seeing you once you've explored Midgard!
scripts.translation: 等你探索完米德加尔特，记得回来找我。保重

scripts.text: Take good care of your Little Poring. Ask the adept adventurer if you have any questions about cute pets!
scripts.translation: 好好照顾你的宝贝波利。关于可爱宠物的问题，记得去问老练的冒险者！

scripts.text: I am da biggest and da meanest Ghostring!
scripts.translation: 我可是最强、最凶的幽灵波利！

scripts.text: Welcome, Kafra service is always close to your heart
scripts.translation: 欢迎！卡普拉服务始终陪伴在你身边。

scripts.text: For those who are using the Kafra service for the first time.
scripts.translation: 第一次使用卡普拉服务吗？我们

scripts.text: Kafra service offers thorough information rundown~!

scripts.translation: 喂食小鸡皮基的小孩还没醒吗？ ^3377FF^000000

scripts.text: You have a pretty name... Anonymous... I am attacted by your work.
scripts.translation: 您的名字真好听...匿名者...您的作品让我着迷。

scripts.text: Ahh. Hey is Sir. Orleons doing well?
scripts.translation: 啊，对了，奥尔良先生最近还好吗？

scripts.text: Are you the new Criatura trainee?
scripts.translation: 你是新来的克里图拉学员吗？

scripts.text: I also learned from Sir. Charles Orleans.
scripts.translation: 我也曾向查尔斯·奥尔良先生学习

scripts.text: Everyone became happy from eating my meals.
scripts.translation: 。大家吃了我做的料理都很开心。

scripts.text: Now it is my pleasure to feed the newbies of the Academy....
scripts.translation: 如今能为学院的新学员们准备料理，是我的荣幸...

scripts.text: Wonder when my order will get taken... it's already been an hour...
scripts.translation: 不知道什么时候才有人来点单...都已经等了一个小时了...

scripts.text: Look at the helpers lingering on the side...
scripts.translation: 看看那些助手，还在旁边晃来晃去...

scripts.text: I already told you eight hundred times! It's buffet style! Ah!
scripts.translation: ...我都跟你说过八百遍了！这是自助餐！真是的！

scripts.text: Buffet? What's that? Can you eat it?
You look down on me because I'm from the country, don't you?
scripts.translation: 吃吗？你是看不起我这个乡下人吧？

scripts.text: Don't tell me it's not difficult to understand! Explain it to me!
scripts.translation: 别跟我说这很难懂！快解释给我听！

scripts.text: I've worked at many different places, but this place is the strangest.
scripts.translation: 我在很多地方工作过，这里却是最奇怪的。

scripts.text: Since the prices have risen I try to get my belly full at every chance I get.
scripts.translation: 物价涨了以后，我只要有机会就尽量吃个饱。

scripts.text: It's been 21 hours since I've been here.
scripts.translation: 我在这里已经待了21个小时

scripts.text: It's a buffet so you can eat without time limit.
scripts.translation: 。这里是自助餐，想吃多久都行。

scripts.text: Eat and digest, eat and digest, heh.
scripts.translation: 吃了消化，消化完再吃，嘿嘿。

scripts.text: Hey, do you know about the gunslinger's own weapon?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你知道神枪手专用的枪械吗？
哈，我就知道你会这么说！

scripts.text: Gunslinger handles 5 kinds of guns and each gun has its own character.
scripts.translation: 神枪手能使用五种枪械，每种枪都有各自的特点。

scripts.text: Hahahaha~ I am also taking the lesson, but I don't know the details as I haven't become a gunslinger.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈～我也在上课，不过还没成为神枪手，所以不清楚具体情况。

scripts.text: I heard that as it was a dangerous weapon they don't let us use them yet!
scripts.translation: 我听说那种武器很危险，所以现在还不让我们用！

scripts.text: What? Why did you take the other job rather than being a nice gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 什么？这么帅的神枪手不当，为什么选了别的职业？

scripts.text: Are you coming to take the lesson for gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 你是来上神枪手课程的吗？

scripts.text: I wish to be a gunslinger, like her.
scripts.translation: 我也想像她一样成为神枪手。

scripts.text: I hope I finish my lessons soon!
scripts.translation: 真希望能快点上完所有课程！

scripts.text: You are a gunslinger? You look great! I want to become a gunslinger......
scripts.translation: 您是神枪手吗？看起来真帅！我也想成为神枪手...

scripts.text: Desperado is the bullet... Blable... Ranged attack... Physics....
scripts.translation: “亡命之徒”就是子弹...叭啦叭啦...远程攻击...物理攻击...

scripts.text: You can't hear her clearly because of her small voice.
scripts.translation: 她声音太小了，听不清她在说什么。

scripts.text: A sudden poetic inspiration hit me!
^3377FFIn the night of the Byalan Island under the moonlight, sitting alone in Izlude^000000
scripts.translation: 月光洒在拜兰岛的夜色中，我独自坐在依斯鲁得。 ^3377FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3377FFWearing Tzurugie on my belly, in the deep anxiety,^000000
scripts.translation: 腰间佩着日本刀，心中满是忧虑， ^3377FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3377FFHearing I made a fortune from somewhere, killing me softly.^000000
scripts.translation: 听说我不知从哪儿发了大财，心里却隐隐作痛。 ^3377FF^000000

scripts.text: How about it? It is excellent, isn't it?
I will ^FF0000transcend ^000000and ^FF00003rd job change^000000. Become a nice Minstrel, I can play with a famous Wanderer like Mr. Igoo.
scripts.translation: 我要转生，再完成三转。成为出色的宫廷乐师后，我就能和伊古小姐这样的知名浪姬舞者一起玩了。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You seem to already know what it is!

scripts.translation: 转生好极了，真的好极了。

scripts.text: Basically the 2nd job adventurer gains the base level 99 and job level 50, on then can that person transcend.
scripts.translation: 简单来说，二转冒险者达到基础等级99级、职业等级50级后，就能转生。

scripts.text: Once you transcend, you can go back to the base level Novice.
scripts.translation: 转生后，你会重新成为初心者。

scripts.text: It is very hard to start your adventure again. However, there is a merit to the hardship.
scripts.translation: 重新开始冒险确实很辛苦，不过这份辛苦也有回报。

scripts.text: The most important merit is to learn new skills at a new upgraded level. In my case, I could transfer to not an ordinary Bard but a Minstrel.
scripts.translation: 最大的好处，就是能在更高阶的职业中学习新技能。就拿我来说，转生后就能从普通诗人进阶为宫廷乐师。

scripts.text: Indeed, be careful as you can only follow the way of the job you chose before transcending.
scripts.translation: 没错，不过要注意，转生后只能沿着转生前选择的职业路线继续发展。

scripts.text: If you are interested in transcending, recommend you visit the Sage castle in ^FF0000Juno^000000. I may be far behind for it.
scripts.translation: 如果您有意转生，建议去朱诺的贤者城堡看看。对我来说，那里还很遥远呢。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Oh, you know very well, don't you?
The 3rd job change is obviously a new job.
scripts.translation: 三转嘛，当然就是转成全新的职业。

scripts.text: Adventurers with the 2nd job or can be transferred to the 3rd job class once gaining the base level 99 and the job level more than 50.
scripts.translation: 二转冒险者达到基础等级99级、职业等级超过50级后，就能转职为三转职业。

scripts.text: For example, a Bard like me was an Archer in the beginning. Now I became a Bard. As I am diligently adventuring, I may be able to change jobs to a third job.
scripts.translation: 比如我这样的诗人，最初也是弓箭手。如今我已经成为诗人，只要继续努力冒险，说不定就能转职为三转职业。

scripts.text: Ah, of course, though I don't make transfer, I could be Minstrel as my final target. However, I won't compromise with the reality. Someday I will be the best Minstrel.
scripts.translation: 当然，即使现在还没法转职，宫廷乐师也是我的终极目标。我绝不会向现实妥协，总有一天要成为最棒的宫廷乐师。

scripts.text: So, if you transfer, you could first be Novice and be a Bard. But someday I could be Minstrel, couldn't I?
scripts.translation: 所以转生后，你会先成为初心者，再转职为诗人。总有一天，我也能成为宫廷乐师，对吧？

scripts.text: Choice is always on you. Be ambitious, adventurer. Someday I will sing an encouraging song for you.
scripts.translation: 选择权在你手中。冒险者，怀抱远大志向吧。总有一天，我会为你唱一首鼓舞人心的歌。

scripts.text: No! You don't know the most beautiful girl Wanderer Igoo in this era?
scripts.translation: 什么！你竟然不知道当今最美的浪姬舞者伊古？

scripts.text: Haven't you heard about [Volume 1 - Lost Poring] or [Volume 2 : Poring my love]?
scripts.translation: 你没听过《第一卷：迷失的波利》或《第二卷：波利，我的爱》吗？

scripts.text: Then, have you never heard the songs like [It's a Good day for an OCA] or [Baphomet I hardly knew you]
scripts.translation: 那么，《今天适合开卡片册》或《巴风特，我几乎不认识你》这样的歌，你也没听过吗？

scripts.text: A beautiful Wanderer from Comodo at the age of 20. Not only Midgard but also wherever her wandering troupe goes, a fan club follows.
scripts.translation: 她是来自克魔岛、年仅20岁的美丽浪姬舞者。不仅在米德加尔特，只要她的巡演团走到哪里，粉丝团就会跟到哪里。

scripts.text: I am ^FF0000Ragie^000000 in charge with the Rune-Midgarts branch head of Igoo's informal fan club! As Igoo has gone to the 2nd world, I am taking a rest for a while. But she will be back soon.
scripts.translation: 我是拉吉埃，负责卢恩-米德加兹分部，也是伊古非正式粉丝团的负责人！伊古去了第二世界，所以我暂时休息一阵子。不过她很快就会回来。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: As I am still a low level of adventurer, I haven't followed her to the 2nd world... See! I will make great efforts and follow her everywhere.
scripts.translation: 我还是个低等级冒险者，没能跟着她去第二世界...看着吧！我会努力提升实力，追随她到天涯海角。

scripts.text: Ahaa. No sweat no sweat. It is useless to tell such a story to those ignorant.
scripts.translation: 啊哈，没什么，没什么。讲给这些不懂的人听也没用。

scripts.text: Ah! I happened to come up with another great poetic inspiration.. Take a memo.. Memo..
scripts.translation: 啊！我又有了绝妙的诗歌灵感...快记下来...记下来...

scripts.text: There is a town called Payon to the east. Taking a long way to the south, you can even reach Alberta.
scripts.translation: 东边有座斐扬城。一路往南走远些，还能到达艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Payon is the wonderful city. There you can be transferred to an Archer or to a Taekwon. And a nice Dungeon there. If you have time, please make a visit.
scripts.translation: 斐扬是座很棒的城市，可以在那里转职为弓箭手或跆拳。那儿还有座不错的地下城。有空一定去看看。

scripts.text: Class aptitude test is nonsense for those who already have a job.
scripts.translation: 已经有职业的人，做职业适性测试也没意义。

scripts.text: You haven't decided your job yet?
scripts.translation: 你还没决定要转什么职业吗？

scripts.text: Have you already decided? Ok then.
scripts.translation: 你已经决定好了？那好吧。

scripts.text: I wanted you to take the Class aptitude test for fun...
scripts.translation: 我本来还想让你做个职业适性测试，玩一玩呢...
知道什么是职业适性测试 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I have one book left. Do you want to try? I won't say it will be help for sure but it will be fun.
scripts.translation: 0000吗？我这里还剩一本测试手册。想试试吗？虽然不保证一定有帮助，不过肯定挺有意思。

scripts.text: The Class aptitude test is a test for recommending jobs by reviewing your personality and capability with the answers.
scripts.translation: 职业适性测试会根据你的回答评估个性和能力，并推荐适合的职业。

scripts.text: It has 3 types of test and each one give 30 minutes to finish.
scripts.translation: 测试分为三种，每种都要在30分钟内完成。

scripts.text: If you have free time and have not decided your job... how about taking this test?
scripts.translation: 如果你有空，又还没决定要转什么职业...不如来做做测试？

scripts.text: The first type of question is about taking an action for a given situation.
scripts.translation: 第一类题目会描述一种情境，再问你会采取什么行动。

scripts.text: In the middle of the dark, you're walking on the street of Prontera when suddenly you hear someone scream.
scripts.translation: 夜色漆黑，你走在普隆德拉的街上，忽然听见有人尖叫。

scripts.text: You run to the place and see someone surrounded by punks. Because of your sudden appearace, the punks are surprised.
scripts.translation: 你赶到现场，发现有人被一群朽魔围住。你的突然出现让朽魔们吃了一惊。

scripts.text: What would be your reaction to this situation?
scripts.translation: 遇到这种情况，你会怎么做？

scripts.text: After clear up the mess, you approach the person who was being attacked.
scripts.translation: 解决眼前的麻烦后，你走近那个被袭击的人

scripts.text: Do you think the person who was surrounded by punks is a man or a woman?
scripts.translation: 。你觉得被朽魔围住的是男人还是女人？

scripts.text: The situation of encountering the gangs were like this
scripts.translation: 事情是这样的：你遇上了一伙帮派成员。

scripts.text: You find out that {0} is the {1} of very rich family in Alberta and Punks attacked while {2} was on an errand for the family
scripts.translation: 你发现{0}是艾尔贝塔某个富裕家族的{1}，而{2}在替家族办事时遭到了朽魔袭击。

scripts.text: What kind of errand was he doing?
For your bravery, {0} becomes your friend and decides to go on a trip.
scripts.translation: 你的英勇表现让{0}成了你的朋友，并决定出门旅行。

scripts.text: You're having a great time. Do you feel like something will be happening or not?
scripts.translation: 你玩得正开心。你觉得接下来会发生什么吗？

scripts.text: Now for the second test. Choose the best answer in your own opinion.
scripts.translation: 接下来是第二项测试。请凭直觉选出你认为最合适的答案。

scripts.text: 2nd type of question is to select a word or sentence which is closest to yourself.
scripts.translation: 第二类题目要从词语或句子中，选出最符合你自己的那一项。

scripts.text: 2nd type of question is done. It was simple. Right ? Let's move to next.
scripts.translation: 第二项测试结束了。很简单吧？那我们继续下一项。

scripts.text: Now for the third test. Please choose (Yes) or (No) to each question.
scripts.translation: 接下来是第三项测试。请对每个问题回答“是”或“否”。

scripts.text: Do you always pick up money that you find on the ground?
scripts.translation: 你总会捡起掉在地上的钱吗？

scripts.text: If you had the same name as someone of the opposite sex, would that make you less attracted to them?
scripts.translation: 如果某个异性和你同名，你会因此对他（她）失去好感吗？

scripts.text: Do you like to be able to carry a lot of items at once?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢一次携带很多物品吗？

scripts.text: Do you like to read books?
You read everything in a magazine?
scripts.translation: 你会把杂志从头到尾都读完吗？

scripts.text: Do you take the time to worry about what you are wearing?
scripts.translation: 你会花时间琢磨自己该穿什么吗？

scripts.text: Do you tell others what kind of fancy foods you've eaten recently?
scripts.translation: 你会和别人聊起最近吃过的美食吗？

scripts.text: Do you write things down in a notebook often?
scripts.translation: 你经常把事情记在笔记本上吗？

scripts.text: Do you like to be in areas where a lot of people gather?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢待在人多热闹的地方吗？

scripts.text: Do you like the idea of living a single life?
Do you like to keep your distance from others?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢和别人保持距离吗？

scripts.text: Do you think that having a good hiding space is important in battle?
scripts.translation: 你认为战斗时有个藏身之处很重要吗？

scripts.text: Would you defend your friend even if you knew they were wrong?
scripts.translation: 即使知道朋友做错了，你也会站出来维护他吗？

scripts.text: Would you try to convince an enemy not to fight you with logic?
scripts.translation: 你会试着讲道理，说服敌人别和你交手吗？

scripts.text: Can you sit still in the same place for a long time?
scripts.translation: 你能长时间待在同一个地方一动不动吗？

scripts.text: Do you think that you can take a punch straight to the gut from an Orc?
scripts.translation: 你觉得自己能硬扛兽人迎面打来的一拳吗？

scripts.text: Do you make up nicknames for your friends?
Do you always have a plan B for various situations?
scripts.translation: 遇到各种情况时，你都会准备好备用方案吗？

scripts.text: I think about something else while talking to others.
scripts.translation: 和别人交谈时，我常常会想着别的事情。

scripts.text: Class aptitude test is finished with 1,2 and 3rd test. Please wait for a moment.
scripts.translation: 职业适性测试的三部分都完成了。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: It requires to manually calculate as you know.
scripts.translation: 你也知道，得手动算一下才行。

scripts.text: Finished calculating. Math is always difficult.
According to the Class aptitude test!
scripts.translation: 根据职业适性测试的结果...

scripts.text: The one who wants to be a hero with stong belief and wants to influence on the world.
scripts.translation: 你坚信自己能成为英雄，并希望改变世界。

scripts.text: The one who wants to protect the weak.
The one who is curious about knowing everything and independently work alone.
scripts.translation: 你对一切都充满好奇，喜欢独立完成事情。

scripts.text: the one who has good judgement, not out-going, analyzing and insightful and likes to observe...
scripts.translation: 你判断力出色，性格内敛，善于分析和观察，洞察力也很敏锐...

scripts.text: The one who is romantic and understands the feeling of others and tries to be understood by others as well.
scripts.translation: 你富有浪漫情怀，既能体会他人的感受，也希望别人理解自己。

scripts.text: The one who wants to spend time finding out who they are.
scripts.translation: 你愿意花时间认识真正的自己。

scripts.text: the one who is good at reading the mind of others and is decisive.
scripts.translation: 你善于洞察人心，做事果断。

scripts.text: the one who is strongly interested in achieving and target-driving and responsible.
scripts.translation: 你渴望有所成就，目标明确，也富有责任感。

scripts.text: The one who wants to have fun is optimistic who loves adventure.
scripts.translation: 你乐观开朗、热爱冒险，总想尽情享受生活。

scripts.text: The one who wants to find out something exciting and wants to donate to the world in his own way.
scripts.translation: 你喜欢寻找新鲜刺激，也想用自己的方式回馈世界。

scripts.text: The one who has a great heart to help others and understand.
scripts.translation: 你心地善良，乐于助人，也善解人意。

scripts.text: The one who wants to be loved and wants to care for others.
scripts.translation: 你渴望得到关爱，也愿意关心他人。

scripts.text: the one who has sound mind from right training.
scripts.translation: 你经过适当的训练，拥有健全的心智。

scripts.text: The one who tries hard everyday with certain belief and tries to make people understand.
scripts.translation: 你怀着坚定的信念，每天努力不懈，也努力让别人理解自己。

scripts.text: The one who is called as a justice giver but also gives chaos and fear.
scripts.translation: 你被称为正义使者，却也会带来混乱与恐惧。

scripts.text: The one who tries to balance between justice and chaos.
scripts.translation: 你努力在正义与混乱之间寻求平衡。

scripts.text: The one who does not want to get attention.
and who is persistant without giving up until reaching the target.
scripts.translation: 你坚持不懈，直到达成目标。

scripts.text: ^8014EB{0}^000000 is a good matching job for you.
You do not have to choose the job from Class aptitude test. That is only just for fun.
scripts.translation: 你不必选择职业适性测试推荐的职业，那只是供你参考、图个乐而已。

scripts.text: If you want, I will send it to the class that was recommended by the aptitude result.
scripts.translation: 如果你愿意，我可以送你去推荐职业的转职导师那里。
没关系，我还想再考虑一下。

scripts.text: Ok, you know what you want I guess.
scripts.translation: 好吧，看来你心里已经有主意了。

scripts.text: Your recommended job is {0}. I will send you to where you can talk to that job professional.
scripts.translation: 为你推荐的职业是{0}。我会送你去见这类职业的导师。

scripts.text: - Quest can't be continued as your overloaded items. -
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry but in order to take the class, y'all have to register first. Ya come back here after registration at that there counter on the 1st floor, ya hear?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，真抱歉！想参加转职考核，得先登记才行。先去一楼柜台登记，登记好再回来，听见了吗？

scripts.text: Gosh Darnit! You are cuter then a piglet! Are ya trying ta learn to be a ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000?
scripts.translation: 天哪！你可比小猪崽还招人喜欢！你想学神枪手吗？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: You're so cute! A ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000 who has true grit wield his weapons bringing justice in these wild times.
scripts.translation: 你真可爱！真正的神枪手胆识过人，在这乱世中挥枪惩恶扬善。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Ya, know you remind me of my little brother, that varmint couldn't shoot the broadside of a barn.. at least not until I taught him.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗？你让我想起我弟弟。那小子以前连谷仓都打不中...直到我教会他为止。

scripts.text: Ya, know you remind me of my little sister, that scamp couldn't shoot the broadside of barn.. At least not until I taught her.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗？你让我想起我妹妹。那丫头以前连谷仓都打不中...直到我教会她为止。

scripts.text: Now y'all need to understand, guns aren't some little thing that you just swing at an animal, you don't wiggle those there fingers and shock them to death.
scripts.translation: 你们得明白，枪可不是拿来对着动物乱挥的小玩意儿，也不是动动手指就能把人电死的东西。

scripts.text: No! You shoot things, which means ya need to aim straight. This takes a lot of ^ff0000dexterity^000000 on the part of the gunslinger.
scripts.translation: 不对！枪是用来射击的，所以瞄准一定得准。这就要求神枪手有很高的灵巧。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Now before ya go running off shooting dem guns in the air, all high fallootin and dancing around. Ya need to understand that this isn't an easy job!
scripts.translation: 别急着跑出去朝天开枪，摆出一副了不起的样子又蹦又跳。你得先明白，这行可没那么容易！

scripts.text: Bullets cost zeny so you need to be sure that everything you shoot is worth the price! We attack at range so that nasty cur with the pig sticker doesn't rustle your jimmies!
scripts.translation: 子弹要花钱，所以每一发都得打得值！咱们从远处攻击，拿刀的恶棍就没法凑上来找你麻烦！

scripts.text: Those low tech barbarians need both Strength and Dexterity in order to fight properly. This isn't true for gunslingers.
scripts.translation: 那些落后的野蛮人得靠力量和灵巧才能好好战斗，神枪手可不一样。

scripts.text: Why our dexterity influences both attack power and accuracy! Remember, Talk slowly but think quickly!
scripts.translation: 因为灵巧既影响攻击力，也影响命中率！记住：说话慢一点，思考快一点！

scripts.text: Do y'all see lots of factories around here? Mines? Alchemical labs? All these things take zeny to run and thats how they fund it!
scripts.translation: 你们看看这附近有多少工厂、矿场和炼金实验室？这些都得花钱才能运转，咱们的子弹钱就是这么来的！

scripts.text: Some other jobs may think it is safe enough to hand any yonkle the strength to seriously hurt someone.
scripts.translation: 有些职业觉得，随便让什么人拥有足以重伤他人的力量也没关系。

scripts.text: But we have to see that you have grit! Remember, fast is good but accurate is better.
scripts.translation: 可我们得先看看你有没有胆识！记住，速度快固然好，打得准更重要。

scripts.text: Y'all can come back now if you gets any more questions.
scripts.translation: 以后还有问题，随时回来找我。

scripts.text: They tell me Criatura Academy is for the novices not yet decided what job to take.
scripts.translation: 听说克里图拉学院专门接收还没决定转什么职业的初心者。

scripts.text: They hired me, gun and all, to show you how to be a gunslinger!
scripts.translation: 他们把我连人带枪一起请来，就是要我教你们怎么当神枪手！

scripts.text: Would you like me to show you how?
Hrmm, you didn't look like you had the grit any how.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我就觉得你没那股胆气。

scripts.text: Hey! What kind of con is this?! You already had a manual!
scripts.translation: 喂！这算什么把戏？！你不是已经有手册了吗？

scripts.text: Here take this manual, I ain't too good at that there book learnin' but I can answer your questions.
scripts.translation: 拿着这本手册吧。我不太会读书，不过你有问题尽管问我。

scripts.text: If you need the battle training, visit <NAVI>[Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 需要战斗训练的话，就去找<NAVI>[苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Oh, sorry! Children cannot become Gunslingers!
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉！小孩子不能成为神枪手！

scripts.text: Perhaps you should talk to your parents about other professions.
scripts.translation: 或许你该和父母商量一下，看看还有哪些职业适合你。

scripts.text: Are you going to learn to shoot as a gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 你想学射击，成为神枪手吗？

scripts.text: Wooo doggy! You aren't ready for the big city yet!
scripts.translation: 哎哟喂！你还没准备好去大城市闯荡呢！

scripts.text: Get to ^ff0000Job Level: ^0000ff10^000000 and come back here and I will help ya!
scripts.translation: 先升到职业等级：10，再回来找我，我就帮你！ ^ff0000^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Y'all ready to take the test to become a gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 你们准备好参加神枪手转职考核了吗？

scripts.text: When ya are ready, come to me!
Okay then, you should find a^ff0000 Mr. Master Miller^000000 and ask him about the test.
scripts.translation: 那好，你去找米勒大师，问问他转职考核的事。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Remember, if you find yourself in a hole, the first thing to do is stop digging!
scripts.translation: 记住，发现自己陷进坑里时，第一件事就是别再往下挖！

scripts.text: Y'all need help with that book?
scripts.translation: 那本手册有什么不懂的，尽管问我。

scripts.text: How do I use this book?
Oh.. I think I know what the problem is,
scripts.translation: 哦...我想我知道问题出在哪儿了。

scripts.text: Ta use the guide, first ya need to equip it. ^ff0000To open the equipment window the Shortcut key is Alt + E.^000000
scripts.translation: 要用这本指南，得先把它装备上。按 Alt + E 可以打开装备窗口。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Sometimes I forget ta do that too! ^ff0000Drag the item from your inventory to the appropriate slot in the equipment window. Alternatively you can double click the item in inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: 我有时也会忘了这一步！把物品从背包拖到装备窗口对应的栏位里就行，也可以在背包里双击物品。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 还有别的问题吗？[露莎]有问题的话，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: Y'all need ta learn how to use the skill?
scripts.translation: 想学怎么使用这个技能吗？

scripts.text: ^ff0000To open the skill window use the short cut Alt + S. The skill will be located in the ETC tab.^000000
scripts.translation: 按 Alt + S 打开技能窗口，然后在 ETC 标签页里找到这个技能。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000You can then drag the skill to your hot bar for easy use!.^000000
scripts.translation: 把技能拖到快捷栏上，用起来就方便多了！ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ... and thats how I learned that When in doubt, let your peco do the thinkin'.
scripts.translation: ...我就是这么学会的：拿不定主意时，就让你的大嘴鸟替你动脑筋。

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 还有别的问题吗？[露莎]有问题的话，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: Well, I don't think that you are quite ready to get a shootin iron. So the training book only shows ya skills that don't need guns.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我看你们还没准备好拿枪。所以这本训练手册只介绍不需要枪械的技能。

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 还有别的问题吗？[露莎]有问题的话，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation: 有问题的话，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: Oh! Are you just darling, a newly minted gunslinger!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！新晋神枪手真讨人喜欢！

scripts.text: Why your shootin iron looks shinier then a silver zeny! Do ya need anything?
scripts.translation: 哟，你那把枪亮得都快赶上银币了！需要什么帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布罗克吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation: 当然行！记得多花点时间练习！

scripts.text: Oh, I am glad to hear that you are so strong!
scripts.translation: 哦，听说你这么厉害，我真替你高兴！

scripts.text: Ah, still in basic training eh? You're not carelessly using Butterfly Wings, right?
scripts.translation: 啊，还在进行基础训练呀？你没随便用蝴蝶翅膀吧？

scripts.text: Are you going to Einbroch to complete basic training?
scripts.translation: 你要去艾音布罗克完成基础训练吗？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布罗克吗？

scripts.text: No, I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 不了，我还有别的事要办。

scripts.text: Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation: 当然行！记得多花点时间练习！

scripts.text: Oh, is that so? If you wish to go to Einbroch but not take the Airship, come speak to me.
scripts.translation: 哦，是吗？如果你想去艾音布罗克又不打算搭飞空艇，就来找

scripts.text: Because you're still training, I will send you there for free.
scripts.translation: 我。你还在训练，我可以免费送你过去。

scripts.text: Ah you're back, and now wearing lovely Gunslinger clothing! It suits you well, congratulations!
scripts.translation: 哟，你回来啦，还穿上了帅气的神枪手服装！很适合你，恭喜！

scripts.text: I just received the news from my brother regarding your achievement of completing basic training.
scripts.translation: 我刚收到哥哥的消息，听说你已经完成基础训练了。

scripts.text: Huh? My brother did not tell you? My brother is the one in charge of Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 咦？我哥哥没告诉你吗？基础训练就是由他负责的。

scripts.text: Louie and Lusa are very similar names, right?
scripts.translation: 路易和露莎这两个名字很像，对吧？

scripts.text: Ha ha~ Well, our relationship is not really that important.
scripts.translation: 哈哈～算了，我们是什么关系也没那么重要。

scripts.text: I have been assigned to conduct Combat Training for the Gunslinger guild.
scripts.translation: 我受命负责神枪手公会的战斗训练。

scripts.text: Gunslingers are very fond of freedom, so the Guild had limited choices to choose from.
scripts.translation: 神枪手向来崇尚自由，所以公会能挑的人选不多。

scripts.text: They suddenly called me to do this. Frankly I think it's a bit absurd.
scripts.translation: 他们突然把我叫来负责这事。说实话，我觉得有点莫名其妙。

scripts.text: But on the basis of there being no previous Combat Training before, I have agreed to help.
scripts.translation: 不过，之前一直没有战斗训练，既然如此，我就答应帮忙了。

scripts.text: So it was decided that we would use this opporunity to help get rid of some of the monsters near Prontera and Izlude.
scripts.translation: 于是我们决定借这个机会，清理普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛附近的魔物。

scripts.text: It should help the people of those areas that are plagued by the same monsters every day.
scripts.translation: 这样也能帮帮那些每天都受同一批魔物侵扰的居民。

scripts.text: In accordance with the principles of guilds, the Combat Training is not mandatory.
scripts.translation: 公会有公会的规矩，战斗训练并非强制参加。

scripts.text: Once you complete a task, talk to me again to complete to process.
scripts.translation: 每完成一项任务，再来找我确认一下就行。

scripts.text: Well that's all! If a task proves to be too difficult you can cancel at any time, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation: 就这些！任务太难的话，随时都可以取消，不用担心。

scripts.text: Haven't started your basic combat training yet have you? What do you want to know about training?
scripts.translation: 你还没开始基础战斗训练吧？想了解训练的哪方面？

scripts.text: How long can I train for?
scripts.translation: 训练能参加到什么时候？

scripts.text: Where do I receive tasks for training?

scripts.translation: 为什么要参加战斗训练？

scripts.text: Basic combat training can be performed until Base Level 20.
scripts.translation: 基础战斗训练可以参加到基础等级20级。

scripts.text: You must've thought that the training would be pretty low because this is still the beginning.
scripts.translation: 你大概以为这只是初级训练，难度不会太高吧？

scripts.text: Sorry! Did I not mention this?
scripts.translation: 抱歉！我没跟你说过这事吗？

scripts.text: You can choose any task you wish from the requests on my desk near the entrance.
scripts.translation: 入口附近的桌上放着任务委托，你想接哪个都行。

scripts.text: Right, ah, why? Well, The Gunslinger guild didn't have any combat training in the beginning.
scripts.translation: 对了，为什么会有这项训练呢？神枪手公会一开始可没有战斗训练。

scripts.text: So they suddenly asked me to perform combat training for new recruits.
scripts.translation: 所以他们突然请我来给新手做战斗训练。

scripts.text: This training is not mandatory if you do not want to do it.
scripts.translation: 不想参加的话，这项训练也不是强制的。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfectly! I have confirmed the 10 Hornets. Kids will be happy.
scripts.translation: 哇，做得真漂亮！我确认过了，10只蜂兵都处理好了。孩子们会高兴的。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 查看报告后，你获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Roda Frogs. Tonight I should get a good sleep.
scripts.translation: 哇，干得漂亮！我确认过了，10只罗达蛙都处理好了。今晚我总算能睡个好觉了。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 查看报告后，你获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirm the 10 Savage Babes. Students who want to develop specialist pets must be very happy.
scripts.translation: 哇，干得漂亮！我确认过了，10只小野猪都处理好了。想培养专精宠物的学员一定会很开心。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 查看报告后，你获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Rockers. Were they hard to catch?
scripts.translation: 哇，干得漂亮！我确认过了，10只蝗虫都处理好了。抓起来很费劲吧？

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 查看报告后，你获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: I have finished processing your completed tasks. Would you like to cancel any existing tasks?
scripts.translation: 我已经处理完你完成的任务了。要取消还没完成的任务吗？

scripts.text: Okay, good luck continuing your training!
Huh? You do not have any assignments to cancel. Are you sure you have them?
scripts.translation: 咦？你没有正在进行、可以取消的任务呀。确定有接任务吗？

scripts.text: You still have some assignments, are they too difficult? Do you want to cancel them?
scripts.translation: 你还有任务没完成，是不是太难了？要取消吗？
那就继续努力，拿出点本事来！

scripts.text: Hornets are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 蜂兵不太好对付吧？要取消这项任务吗？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任务的话，就拿不到奖励了，知道吗？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment A>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已经取消<任务A>了，这下不用担心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment B>.
Roda Frogs are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 罗达蛙不太好对付吧？要取消这项任务吗？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任务的话，就拿不到奖励了，知道吗？

scripts.text: Oh... Roda Frogs are too tough?
scripts.translation: 哦...罗达蛙太难对付了吗？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment B>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已经取消<任务B>了，这下不用担心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment C>.
Savage Babe are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 小野猪不太好对付吧？要取消这项任务吗？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任务的话，就拿不到奖励了，知道吗？

scripts.text: Oh... Savage Babe are too tough?
scripts.translation: 哦...小野猪太难对付了吗？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment C>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已经取消<任务C>了，这下不用担心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment D>.
scripts.translation: 你也正在进行<任务D>。[露莎]蝗虫不太好对付吧？要取消这项任务吗？

scripts.text: Rockers are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: [露莎]蝗虫不太好对付吧？要取消这项任务吗？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任务的话，就拿不到奖励了，知道吗？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment D>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已经取消<任务D>了，这下不用担心了。

scripts.text: I have cancelled all the assignments you wished to cancel. If you have a hard time with any others, please come see me.
scripts.translation: 你想取消的任务都已取消。其他任务如果做起来有困难，记得来找我。

scripts.text: Times flies, your basic training is coming to an end!
scripts.translation: 时间过得真快，你的基础训练快结束了！

scripts.text: You have worked hard during this period! You have become a good marksman.
scripts.translation: 这段时间辛苦了！你已经成长为一名出色的射手。

scripts.text: However, you have still not completed your tasks.
scripts.translation: 不过，你还有任务没有完成。

scripts.text: You cannot receive any rewards if you do not complete the tasks assigned to you.
scripts.translation: 分配给你的任务都完成后，才能领取奖励。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 查看报告后，你获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Your Gunslinger basic training is now over.
scripts.translation: 你的神枪手基础训练到此结束。

scripts.text: Oh my god! It's you again!
Same old, same old. Every day teaching newbies about Gunslingers. But I love it.
scripts.translation: 还是老样子，每天教新人神枪手的知识。不过我挺喜欢这份工作。

scripts.text: Oh yeah! My brother said he hasn't seen you for a long time. Be sure to take some time to visit him.
scripts.translation: 对了！我哥哥说好久没见到你了，记得抽空去看看他。

scripts.text: Howdy! It's nice to see you again.
Huh! You seem to have transferred into a different class, why have you come here?
scripts.translation: 咦，你好像转成别的职业了，怎么又来这儿了？

scripts.text: Huh? Huh? Where are you going?
You cannot have more than one job. But you seem really serious to learn.
scripts.translation: 一个人不能同时拥有两个职业。不过你看起来是真的很想学。

scripts.text: Since this is my job, and because it's no trouble, I will give you a simple explaination!
scripts.translation: 反正这是我的工作，也不费事，我就给你简单讲讲吧！

scripts.text: Gunslingers is a class with long-range attacks. However, unlike arrows, bullets are expensive. This tends to give beginners some reason for concern.
scripts.translation: 神枪手擅长远程攻击。不过子弹不像箭矢那么便宜，所以新手常会为弹药发愁。

scripts.text: Isn't that a little too simple?
Huh, is it? What else do you want to know?
scripts.translation: 咦，是吗？你还想了解什么？

scripts.text: Gunslingers is a long-range attack class, so hand agility (DEX) will be very important.
scripts.translation: 神枪手是远程攻击职业，所以灵巧（DEX）非常重要。

scripts.text: If you want to increase your attack power, then you must strengthen your hands.
scripts.translation: 想提高攻击力，就得提升力量属性。

scripts.text: Gunslinger skills are not like other classes. Each weapon type has skills that can be specifically used with them.
scripts.translation: 神枪手的技能和其他职业不太一样，每种武器都有专属技能。

scripts.text: Like with other classes, there is no standard toward which skills you should learn.
scripts.translation: 和其他职业一样，技能没有固定的学习路线，按自己的想法选择就行。

scripts.text: Gunslingers have five different kinds of guns.
scripts.translation: 神枪手可以使用五种不同的枪械。

scripts.text: Revolvers have low hit rates, but the attack speed is fast.
scripts.translation: 左轮手枪命中率较低，但攻击速度很快。

scripts.text: Rifles are average in their performance, and is typically the weapon of choice for new Gunslingers.
scripts.translation: 步枪性能均衡，通常是新手神枪手的首选。

scripts.text: Shotguns have strong attack power, but pretty low attack speeds.
scripts.translation: 霰弹枪攻击力很强，但攻击速度比较慢。

scripts.text: Gatling guns have quite a fast attack speed, but the attack power is low.
scripts.translation: 加特林机枪射速很快，但攻击力较低。

scripts.text: Gernade Launchers can be used for strong ground attacks, but the bullets will be consumed quickly.
scripts.translation: 榴弹发射器可以发动强力的范围攻击，不过弹药消耗得很快。

scripts.text: Phew~ I hope I answered all your questions. This is the first time I've seen someone want to study other classes.
scripts.translation: 呼～希望这些回答能解决你的疑问。我还是头一回碰到想了解其他职业的人。

scripts.text: Do you have any other questions?
Phew~ I hope I answered all your questions. This is the first time I've seen someone want to study other classes.
scripts.translation: 呼～希望这些回答能解决你的疑问。我还是头一回碰到想了解其他职业的人。

scripts.text: There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation: 桌上堆着许多文件，似乎是普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛居民提交的任务委托。

scripts.text: There is a stack of papers on the desk.
On the outskirts of the village is a very bad Hornet, because of this, the children cannot play outside. Please get rid of 10 Hornets.
scripts.translation: ：孩子们村庄边缘有只凶恶的蜂兵，害得孩子们都不能在外面玩耍。请消灭10只蜂兵。

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment A>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任务A>的详细信息。按 Alt + U 可以查看。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在进行这项任务。露莎说，如果想放弃，就去找她谈谈。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已经完成这项任务了，该去找露莎领取奖励。

scripts.text: Recently, Roda Frogs have been keeping me awake at night. Get rid of 10 Roda Frogs so I can get a good nights rest.
scripts.translation: 民 H最近罗达蛙总在夜里吵得我睡不着。请消灭10只罗达蛙，让我能睡个好觉。

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment B>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已经完成这项任务了，该去找露莎领取奖励。

scripts.text: I want a cute pet of my own to walk around with. Can you help me catch 10 Savage Babes?
scripts.translation: 学员我想养一只可爱的宠物陪在身边。能帮我抓10只小野猪吗？

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment C>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.

scripts.translation: 我正在进行这项任务。露莎说，如果想放弃，就去找她谈谈。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已经完成这项任务了，该去找露莎领取奖励。

scripts.text: I heard some Rockers were having a singing contest, but I got lost, can you help me catch 10 Rockers? One day Rockers will disappear from the world!
scripts.translation: 人听说有些蝗虫在举办歌唱比赛，可我迷路了。能帮我抓10只蝗虫吗？总有一天，我要让蝗虫从世上消失！

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment D>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任务D>的详细信息。按 Alt + U 可以查看。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在进行这项任务。露莎说，如果想放弃，就去找她谈谈。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已经完成这项任务了，该去找露莎领取奖励。

scripts.text: There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation: 桌上堆着许多文件，似乎是普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛居民提交的任务委托。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items. -
Yesssssss? I wass sssent by the academy.
I am ^A2563ESharp Snake's Fang^000000 from the Gunslinger Guild. What do you need?
scripts.translation: 我是神枪手公会的锐利的蛇牙。有什么事？ ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation: 你就是哥哥提到的那个人吧。

scripts.text: You don't need to worry, he said you're doing great!
scripts.translation: 别担心，他说你表现得很出色！

scripts.text: Do you wish to exchange your guild issued weapon?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的武器吗？

scripts.text: Let's first check your gun's condition.
scripts.translation: 先让我检查一下你的枪。

scripts.text: If you want to proceed, you need to have your weapon equipped.
scripts.translation: 要继续的话，得先把武器装备上。

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Revolver?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的左轮手枪吗？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Rifle?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的步枪吗？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Shotgun?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的霰弹枪吗？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Gatling Gun?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的加特林机枪吗？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Grenade Launcher?
scripts.translation: 你想更换公会配发的榴弹发射器吗？

scripts.text: The gun you are using is was not provided by the guild.
scripts.translation: 你现在用的这把枪不是公会配发的。

scripts.text: The gun looks to be in good condition.
scripts.translation: 这把枪看起来保养得不错。

scripts.text: Please select the novice weapon you wish to exchange for your {0}!
scripts.translation: 请选择要用来换取{0}的初心者武器！

scripts.text: You already have that gun, just use it!
scripts.translation: 你已经有这把枪了，直接用就行！

scripts.text: It's time to choose your job? How about Taekwon {0}? You may be a nice adult like me.
scripts.translation: 是时候选职业了吧？考虑一下跆拳{0}？你也可以像我一样成为出色的大人。

scripts.text: I want to follow the Taekwon way!!!
Do you want to know about taekwon boy/girl? You want to be a cool guy like me right?
scripts.translation: 想了解跆拳少年/少女吗？你也想像我一样成为帅气的人吧？

scripts.text: Make the world wonderful by making a strong body with the right spirit. That's the Taekwondo motto!
scripts.translation: 以正确的精神锻炼强健的体魄，让世界变得更美好。这就是跆拳道的座右铭！

scripts.text: Later if you are trained to be a stronger body, you can change your job to ^FF0000Taekwon Master^000000 or a ^FF0000Soul Linker ^000000.
scripts.translation: 等你把身体锻炼得更强健，就可以转职为拳圣或悟灵士。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: It is not an easy way. So I don't like to recommend it to you if you aren't fully prepared. But it is definitely a nice and great way to follow!!
scripts.translation: 这条路可不轻松，没做好准备的话，我可不建议你走。不过，只要下定决心，这绝对是一条很棒的路！

scripts.text: Introduction to the class may let you know about what Taekwon in more detail.
scripts.translation: 职业介绍能让你更深入地了解跆拳。

scripts.text: If you are really anxious about Taekown, I would like to recommend you a brief introduction. Will you use it?
scripts.translation: 如果你特别想了解跆拳，我可以给你一份简要介绍。要看看吗？

scripts.text: Every adventurer may have their own job! Hope you can find what you want!
scripts.translation: 每位冒险者都有自己的职业道路！希望你能找到心仪的职业！

scripts.text: Go to the [Misc] tab on Skill Window after equipping the Manual and there you will see some skills.
scripts.translation: 装备手册后，打开技能窗口并切换到[其他]标签页，就能看到一些技能。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Flying Kick^000000 is the skill to approach rapidly and attack the enemy! It fully contains the typical feature of Taekwon!
scripts.translation: 飞脚踢可以迅速接近敌人并发动攻击！这招充分体现了跆拳的特色！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Warm Wind^000000 is the skill to change the feature of attacks. This is the essential skill for ^FF0000Taekwon unable to use weapons^000000.
scripts.translation: 暖风可以改变攻击的属性，是无法使用武器的跆拳职业必学的技能。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: While taking the Quest, experience the skills of a Taekwon! You could meet an adept trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation: 接下任务，亲自体验跆拳技能吧！一楼就有位资深教练。

scripts.text: Want to follow the Taekwon way? Let me see....
scripts.translation: 想走跆拳这条路吗？我看看...

scripts.text: Taekwon is the tough way training himself rather than learning from somebody. However, if you want to follow, I will recommend you to a trainer.
scripts.translation: 跆拳之道讲究自我磨练，而不是依赖别人。不过你要是想加入，我可以给你推荐一位教练。

scripts.text: Training is on you, but he will give you the direction for training. I can take you about there. Want to go now?
scripts.translation: 训练得靠你自己，不过他会为你指点方向。我可以带你过去，现在就走吗？

scripts.text: Let me think a little more.
Choose it with discretion. It is a matter of your future adventure.
scripts.translation: 慎重考虑再做决定吧，这关系到你今后的冒险。

scripts.text: You can find a boy with the same appearance as me, when you get in the town through ^FF0000the west entrance^000000, and continue follow the way ^FF0000to the north^000000 after passing the pub house but just before the archer town.
scripts.translation: 从西门进城，经过酒馆后继续往北走，快到弓箭手之村前，你会看到一个长得和我一模一样的男孩。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: To follow the Taekwon way, you have to get to job level 10. To be a Taekwon, train yourself until you get to job level 10!
scripts.translation: 想走跆拳之道，就得先把职业等级升到10级。努力训练，成为跆拳吧！

scripts.text: If you feel difficult in training alone, make a visit to the trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation: 要是觉得独自训练很辛苦，就去一楼找那位教练吧。

scripts.text: Ahahaha.. It is already time? While I am inside... Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈...已经到时间了吗？我还在里面呢...别担心。

scripts.text: If you are interested in being a Taekwon making a healthy body with strong sprit, you can learn a lot here.
scripts.translation: 如果你想成为跆拳，锻炼强健的体魄和坚定的精神，这里有很多东西可以学。

scripts.text: What do you think? Are you interested in being a Taekwon? I don't push you to do! But if you do, I may become your trainer.. So..
scripts.translation: 怎么样？想成为跆拳吗？我不会勉强你！不过你要是愿意，我可以当你的教练...怎么样？

scripts.text: Is that so!? You are!? Yaho! Now I am a teacher! Now, ask me whatever!
scripts.translation: 真的吗！？你真的愿意！？耶！我现在也是老师了！想问什么尽管问！

scripts.text: Hahaha.. You are interested in me?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈...你是对我有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Suddenly, you see Arang's foot flying towards you.
scripts.translation: 阿朗突然朝你飞踢过来。

scripts.text: You look like a naive beginner? If you want to get in the class, come after registering on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation: 你看起来还是个没经验的新人。想参加课程的话，先去一楼登记再回来。

scripts.text: Are you diligently training? Once you are trained well, you could become a Taekwon Master or a Soul Linker.
scripts.translation: 你训练得很努力吧？练得足够强之后，就能成为拳圣或悟灵士。

scripts.text: You became a nice Taekwon Master!? Please keep in mind power is followed by responsibility.
scripts.translation: 你已经成为出色的拳圣了！？记住，能力越大，责任越大。

scripts.text: Handling spirits is a very delicate job to do, I heard. Excellent! The adventurer led by me has grown up like this.
scripts.translation: 听说操控灵魂是一项非常细致的工作。太棒了！我带出来的冒险者已经成长到这一步了。

scripts.text: Ehra! I thought you followed the Taekwon way~~ it is regretful but everyone has their own life, hehe.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！我还以为你会走跆拳之道呢～～虽然有点遗憾，不过每个人都有自己的路，哈哈。

scripts.text: I am propagating the way of Taekwons!
As I can't recall, I feel the shock that something hit me on my head.
scripts.translation: 我想不起发生了什么，只觉得头上挨了一下。

scripts.text: ^FF0000I should look for somebody to heal me nearby.^000000.
Why are you carrying so much with you? Unload it somewhere and come back.
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？先找地方存起来再回来吧。

scripts.text: You were never trained by me.
scripts.translation: 你没有接受过我的训练。

scripts.text: Then, I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation: 那我也没什么可教你的。

scripts.text: I see you received a complete education in Payon.
scripts.translation: 看来你在斐扬接受了完整的训练。

scripts.text: Then again... you may want to learn more.
scripts.translation: 不过...也许你还想再多学一些。

scripts.text: Either way, there is nothing I can teach you.
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，我已经没什么能教你的了。

scripts.text: Ah~ You've become a skilled Archer.
scripts.translation: 啊～你已经是个熟练的弓箭手了。

scripts.text: The difference is great now compared to when you were a novice!
scripts.translation: 和你还是初心者时相比，进步可真大！

scripts.text: Because of my teachings, you have grown very fast!
scripts.translation: 多亏了我的教导，你才能进步这么快！

scripts.text: Sniff sniff! It is the smell of a novice!
scripts.translation: 嗅嗅！这是初心者的气息！见到你

scripts.text: I can guess most, but hehehehe~~
Please feel comfortable and tell me everything you want!
scripts.translation: 嘿～～放轻松，想问什么尽管说！

scripts.text: I get bored! Play with me!
You think this is just some kids playground?
scripts.translation: 玩？你当这儿是小孩子的游乐场吗？

scripts.text: If you are bored, walk around and punch a monster in the face and see what happens.
scripts.translation: 无聊的话就出去走走，朝魔物脸上揍一拳，看看会怎样。

scripts.text: Oh dear~ another sheep here to get a free lesson from me.
scripts.translation: 哎呀～又来个想白听我课的愣头青。

scripts.text: The main point of Archers is to use bows to attack enemies quickly from a long distance.
scripts.translation: 弓箭手最擅长用弓箭从远处迅速攻击敌人。

scripts.text: Only problem is they are physically weak.
scripts.translation: 唯一的缺点是身板比较弱。

scripts.text: But, it doesn't matter if they are trained correctly.
scripts.translation: 不过，只要训练得当就不是问题。

scripts.text: What do you want to know about an Archer? I will tell you everything~
scripts.translation: 想了解弓箭手的什么？我都可以告诉你～听完我

scripts.text: With my full explanation~, you can be an excellent one.
scripts.translation: 的详细讲解，你也能成为出色的弓箭手。

scripts.text: I want to become an Archer.
Are you curious about the Archer's stats?
scripts.translation: 对弓箭手的属性感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Do you know the most necessary stats for Archers?
scripts.translation: 你知道弓箭手最需要哪项属性吗？

scripts.text: To raise up the attacking power in other jobs, Str should be raised but Archers vary in accordance with their Dex figures.
scripts.translation: 其他职业通常要提升力量（STR）来增加攻击力，弓箭手则主要靠灵巧（DEX）。

scripts.text: Here is a simple question! What is the name of the stat determining the Archer's attacking power?
scripts.translation: 来个简单的问题！决定弓箭手攻击力的属性是什么？

scripts.text: If you want to know more about the role of other stats, ^0000cdopen the status window by pressing ALT+Q.^000000
scripts.translation: 想了解其他属性的作用，就按 Alt + Q 打开属性窗口。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you are curious about stats except Dex, you can check it out.
scripts.translation: 想了解灵巧以外的属性，可以自己看看。

scripts.text: If you have a job later, you can reset the stats anyway.
scripts.translation: 以后转职了，反正还能重置属性。

scripts.text: Hey, just click this and that!
scripts.translation: 喏，点这里，再点那里就行！

scripts.text: Hmm. You are interested in skills? Then, let's study ^0000cdskill^000000s.
scripts.translation: 嗯，对技能感兴趣？那我们来看看技能吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I thought you would better experience the skill than talking, so I prepared the experience of the archer's skill in a manual.
scripts.translation: 光听我讲不如亲自试试，所以我把弓箭手技能的体验内容整理进了手册。

scripts.text: Archer have a lot of very useful skills.
scripts.translation: 弓箭手有很多实用技能。

scripts.text: But regretfully as most of them are skills useful only with arrows and bows, you can't experience them.
scripts.translation: 可惜大多数技能都得配合弓箭使用，所以没法在这里体验。

scripts.text: There is a useful skill without a bow... Called ^0000cdImprove Concentration^000000
scripts.translation: 有个实用技能不需要弓箭...叫作心神凝聚。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: At the same time, it will reveal hidden enemies nearby.
scripts.translation: 它还能同时显现附近隐匿的敌人。

scripts.text: If you want to know more anout skill, then open the skill window by pressing the key  ^0000cdALT+S^000000
scripts.translation: 想了解更多技能，就按Alt + S打开技能窗口。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: When you scoll the mouse on the skill icon, there pops up the details about the skill. Please read it.
scripts.translation: 把鼠标停在技能图标上，就会显示技能详情。记得看看。

scripts.text: To use skills, click the skill icon on the skill window. Then drag and register it on the ^0000cdshortcut window^000000 to use conveniently.
scripts.translation: 要使用技能，先点击技能窗口里的技能图标，再把它拖到快捷栏，使用起来更方便。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Will you go and find a hunting teacher on the 1st floor? if you do not want, then no need.
scripts.translation: 要去一楼找狩猎教练吗？不想去也没关系。

scripts.text: But he may train you with a lot of useful hunting skills for you.
scripts.translation: 不过，他可以教你许多实用的狩猎技巧。

scripts.text: Do you want to become an^0000cd Archer^000000?
It hasn't been a long time since we met together. But I am sad about saying good bye to you.
scripts.translation: 0000吗？我们才刚认识不久，一想到要和你道别，我还真有点舍不得。

scripts.text: Let me check a little while, before you change your job you have to be at job level 10.
scripts.translation: 我先确认一下：转职前，你的职业等级必须达到10级。

scripts.text: Do you really want to become an Archer?

scripts.text: It seems that you've come from Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 看来你是从克里图拉学院来的。

scripts.text: Though.. to become a magician is exhausting in a way...
scripts.translation: 不过，成为魔法师确实也挺耗神的...

scripts.text: First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
scripts.translation: 我的工作就是带你去魔法师公会！一直往右走！

scripts.text: After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!

scripts.translation: 你应该能找到我们的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法师公会向导]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation: 和他交谈，他会继续带你去魔法师公会！

scripts.text: First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!

scripts.text: After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!

scripts.text: Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation: 和他交谈，他会继续带你去魔法师公会！

scripts.text: I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
scripts.translation: 我负责带克里图拉学院的学生去魔 ^8B4513^000000

scripts.text: These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation: 法师公会。最近学院来了很多新生，我也忙得很开心。

scripts.text: Ah, you made it all the way here. Very good for an academy student!
scripts.translation: 你居然一路走到了这里，真不愧是学院的学生！

scripts.text: Before this step-by-step guide, they would get lost and frustrated.
scripts.translation: 以前没有这样一步步的指引，学生们总会迷路，急得团团转。

scripts.text: I will now tell you the route to the Mage's Guild!
scripts.translation: 我这就告诉你去魔法师公会的路线

scripts.text: The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation: 从这里朝11点钟方向走，就能看到公会。

scripts.text: Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
scripts.translation: 直接进去，再上楼走一小段，就能找到

scripts.text: From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation: 他会帮你转职为魔法师。
