From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation: 里朝11点钟方向走，就能看到魔法师公会。

scripts.text: Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
scripts.translation: 直接进去，再上楼走一小段，就能找到

scripts.text: From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation: 他会帮你转职为魔法师。

scripts.text: I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
scripts.translation: 我负责带克里图拉学院的学生去魔 ^8B4513^000000

scripts.text: These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation: 法师公会。最近学院来了很多新生，我也忙得很开心。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded. -
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: This class only for Novices just starting their adventure.
scripts.translation: ？这门课程只面向刚开始冒险的初心者。

scripts.text: Looking at you, you seem like you need some help. How about going to another place?
scripts.translation: 看起来你需要帮忙。要不要我带你去别处？

scripts.text: At a glance, hey, you like the lost baby sheep.. Here the non registered passengers are prohibited.
scripts.translation: ～一看你就像只迷路的小羊羔...这里不允许未登记的乘客进入。

scripts.text: If you want to look around this area without physical prohibiton, you would better register first at the info desk at the Academy entrance.
scripts.translation: 想在这片区域自由活动的话，最好先去学院入口的信息台登记。

scripts.text: You look like you're ready to change to a first job.
scripts.translation: 看起来你已经准备好转职为一转职业了。

scripts.text: How about it? Are you interested in the way of the Merchant? If so, I may be helpful for you.
scripts.translation: 怎么样？你对商人这条路感兴趣吗？如果有兴趣，我可以帮你。

scripts.text: Well, there is no way. Our Criatura Academy put the priority to the adventurer's choice.
scripts.translation: 这样啊...好吧，没办法。克里图拉学院会优先尊重冒险者自己的选择。

scripts.text: Good~ Then, I will send you to the town of Alberta. There you can become a merchant.
scripts.translation: 很好～那我就送你去艾尔贝塔。在那里你可以转职为商人。

scripts.text: Do not go elsewhere, immediately enter the town.
Yes, I understand. When you are ready, let me see you again.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我明白了。准备好后再来找我。

scripts.text: Good~ Please go to the Forge and find me.
Hey, you like a lost sheep. Do you know why you've come here?
scripts.translation: ～嘿，你看起来像只迷路的小羊。知道自己为什么来这里吗？

scripts.text: Oh~ you seem like a quick learner.
Well, I should at least give a briefing.
scripts.translation: 好吧，至少先给你简单介绍一下。

scripts.text: I am ^0000ffSalim Hamid^000000 in charge with training the merchant course here at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 我是萨利姆·哈米德，负责克里图拉学院的商人课程。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: This classroom is for Merchant applicants. In fact, this room is mainly for doing the finacial management of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 这间教室是给商人课程学员用的。实际上，这里主要负责学院的财务管理。

scripts.text: Next time, if you want to observe the merchant course, you can visit me, Salim Hamid and register.
scripts.translation: 下次想旁听商人课程的话，来找我萨利姆·哈米德登记就行。

scripts.text: Oh~ You came back. Do you want to experience the Merchant training course? It is a little bit difficult to the average beginner.
scripts.translation: 哦～你回来啦。想体验商人培训课程吗？对一般的新手来说，这课稍微有点难。

scripts.text: Oh~ though it is a bit hard, it is worth learning. Sadly, there's no other way.
scripts.translation: 哦～虽然有点难，但很值得学。可惜没有别的办法。

scripts.text: Oh, yes... Then, first will you register your name in this student list?
scripts.translation: 哦，对了...先在这份学员名单上写下你的名字吧？

scripts.text: Put your name on the list.
Resistance from the beginning? This isn't the way to start training.
scripts.translation: 一开始就打退堂鼓？这样可没法开始训练。

scripts.text: First to observe the Merchant course, you need to have the Merchant mindset. A trader with less than 100 zeny could not be called a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 想旁听商人课程，首先要有商人的头脑。身上连100 Zeny都不到，可算不上商人。

scripts.text: {0}^000000 come back to me with 100 Zeny in hand before the next class.
scripts.translation: {0}^000000，下次上课前记得带着100 Zeny来找我。

scripts.text: Of course, that money won't be taken. It is only A test to see your basic mindset to being a Merchant. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 当然，我不会收走这笔钱。这只是测试你有没有成为商人的基本意识。祝你好运。

scripts.text: Wow, you really came back with 100 zeny in hand. I feel your desire to learn clearly.
scripts.translation: 哇，你真的带着100 Zeny回来了。我能感受到你求知的热情。

scripts.text: Now. I will give you a Merchant's manual. Equipped with it. Press Alt + S key and look at the skill window.
scripts.translation: 好，我给你一本商人入门手册。装备上它，再按 Alt + S 打开技能窗口。

scripts.text: Clicking the [MISC] tab on the skill window, you can see the Merchant manual skills.
scripts.translation: 点击技能窗口里的[杂项]标签，就能看到商人手册中的技能。

scripts.text: Now~ as we should go to the next course, equip the guide and see the skill, then speak to me again.
scripts.translation: 接下来要上下一堂课了。先装备手册，看看里面的技能，再回来找我。

scripts.text: Hohohong.. Test is not easy? Will you give it up now?
scripts.translation: 呵呵呵...测试很难吗？现在要放弃了？

scripts.text: Will you? 100 zeny isn't hard to get pal.
scripts.translation: 真要放弃吗？朋友，100 Zeny可不难赚。

scripts.text: Yes, come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 好吧，改变主意后再来找我。

scripts.text: Now, how about attending the class concerning various basic skills which merchants should have for making money.
scripts.translation: 接下来上一堂课，学学商人赚钱所需的各种基础技能吧。

scripts.text: This might be better for you to learn from the steward working on the field next door. Go to him for the Merchant theory course, then return to me.
scripts.translation: 隔壁田地里有位管家，或许他更适合教你。先去上商人理论课，再回来找我。

scripts.text: Haven't you gone to him for the class? Go to the steward next to me and return after completing the Merchant skill theory.
scripts.translation: 你还没去上课吗？去我旁边找那位管家，学完商人技能理论后再回来。

scripts.text: Have you come after a good lesson from the steward concerning what a Merchant can do?
scripts.translation: 你听完那位管家讲商人能做什么了吗？

scripts.text: By any chance, {0} do you have mind to learn more about Merchants here?
scripts.translation: 对了，{0}，你还想在这里多了解一些商人的知识吗？

scripts.text: I will look around at more jobs.
Let me do it a little more.
Yes, your open mind is good for you. As this academy has many other lecturers besides Merchants.
scripts.translation: 很好～愿意多方了解对你有好处。学院里除了商人课程，还有很多其他讲师。

scripts.text: Whenever you feel like learning again, come back to me {0}.
scripts.translation: {0}，什么时候想继续学习，都可以回来找我。

scripts.text: Is that so? OK, now how about learning the major effects of Merchant's stats? If you are ready, speak to me.
scripts.translation: 是吗？好，那我们来讲讲商人各项属性的主要作用。准备好了就跟我说。

scripts.text: Trader's stats are classified as two major series. One is for manufacturing, the other is for battle.
scripts.translation: 商人的属性配点大致分为两类：一类用于制造，另一类用于战斗。

scripts.text: Of course, these are for farther down in the future. At this moment, you are even short of stats to invest DEX enabling you to hunt a monster.
scripts.translation: 这些都是以后的事了。眼下你连打怪所需的灵巧（DEX）都还不够呢。

scripts.text: But, there is a big difference between your knowledge of the basic rules and being ignorant of it.
scripts.translation: 不过，懂得基本原则和一无所知可大不一样。我们

scripts.text: Let's learn about it one by one.
Now, what series do we start with?
scripts.translation: 那我们先从哪一类讲起？

scripts.text: It will be OK as it is, won't it?
scripts.translation: 保持这样也没问题，对吧？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
Yes, you are {0} I am pleased to meet a quick-to-learn student like you. It also saves my time.
scripts.translation: 没错，你就是{0}。能遇到像你这样一点就通的学生真好，也省了我的时间。

scripts.text: Aha~ I think I got you wrong. Let's start the lecture again.
scripts.translation: 啊～看来我误会你了。那我们重新开始讲吧。[萨利姆·哈米德]好，这堂课就到这里。还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text: Being in a trader role, the stats affecting the figure of battle power are two ^4d4fffSTR & DEX^000000.
scripts.translation: 商人的战斗能力主要受两项属性影响：力量（STR）和灵巧（DEX）。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: STR is related to the basic attacking power, DEX is to hit ratio and recovery from damage.
scripts.translation: 力量（STR）影响基础攻击力，灵巧（DEX）则影响命中率和受伤后的恢复速度。

scripts.text: In you future, according to the 2nd and 3rd jobs you choose, you can learn additional attacking stats such ^4d4fffINT or AGI^000000.
scripts.translation: 以后选择二转或三转职业后，还可以根据职业需求提升智力（INT）或敏捷（AGI）等属性。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: To back up your shortage, you can increase LUK a little.
scripts.translation: 也可以稍微提高一点幸运（LUK），弥补其他方面的不足。

scripts.text: Rather than worry yourself, it may be a good idea to learn from other Merchants. You know ask others for advice.
scripts.translation: 别一个人闷头苦想，多向其他商人请教就好。遇到问题可以找人商量嘛。
还有其他问题吗？[萨利姆·哈米德]好，这堂课就到这里。还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text: The stats concerning crafting is simpler than that concerning battle. Only difficulty is how to cultivate it.
scripts.translation: 制造型商人的属性配点比战斗型简单，难点只在于怎么培养。

scripts.text: It is common that you increase ^4d4fffDEX & LUK^000000 as the base and, if you have surplus, you invest the rest in ^4d4fffINT^000000.
scripts.translation: 通常以灵巧（DEX）和幸运（LUK）为主，有剩余点数的话，再投到智力（INT）上。 ^4d4fff^000000^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: Of course, the allocation of the portion should be properly adjusted in accordance with your equipments and the status you are in.
scripts.translation: 当然，具体怎么分配，还得看你的装备和当前状况。

scripts.text: One thing you should keep in mind is it may be a very boring and ascetic way to grow alone as Merchant specializing in crafting.
scripts.translation: 有一点要记住：专精制造的商人若是单打独斗，成长过程可能会很枯燥，也很艰苦。

scripts.text: If possible, make use of your friends and their items if you can.
scripts.translation: 有需要的话，不妨请朋友帮忙，也借用一下他们

scripts.text: This is my personal opinion only.
It is absolutely not the official standpoint of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 个人意见，绝不代表克里图拉学院的官方立场。
还有其他问题吗？[萨利姆·哈米德]好，这堂课就到这里。还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text: Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation: 。还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text: You came back again. {0} this time, shall we have a practical training by doing a simple errand?
scripts.translation: 你又回来啦，{0}。这次要不要做个简单的跑腿任务，来练习实战？

scripts.text: Can you see the noisy vending machine at the corner of this classroom? It was originally a soft drink vending machine but swallows coin very much...
scripts.translation: 看到教室角落那台吵闹的自动贩卖机了吗？它原本卖饮料，不过特别会吞硬币...

scripts.text: Anyway, due to this reason, it is now being used for the trainees' practice of skills. Please check the prices for Garlet and Zargon.
scripts.translation: 总之，现在学员会用它来练习技能。去查查加勒结晶和刹勒空结晶的价格吧。

scripts.text: But! You should come back wit the information about ^4d4fffthe discounted prices equipped with the merchant's manual and applied with the discount rate^000000.
scripts.translation: 不过！记得装备商人手册、使用折扣技能后，再把t折扣后的价格带回来。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: Don't buy them. Just come back with the checked prices only. Can you do it?
scripts.translation: 别买，只要查好价格回来告诉我就行。办得到吗？

scripts.text: I will do it next time.
OK. Then you challenge it next time.
Good~ I will see you later.
Yes. Let's see the prices you checked.
scripts.translation: 好，给我看看你查到的价格。

scripts.text: I will come back after rechecking them.
OK. You come back after rechecking them in detail.
scripts.translation: 好，仔细核对完再回来找我。

scripts.text: OK~ You correctly checked the prices equipped with Merchant's Manual.
scripts.translation: 不错～你查到的是装备商人手册后的正确价格。

scripts.text: Perhaps, if you become a Merchant and use the high level of discount skill, you can buy what you want at much cheaper prices.
scripts.translation: 等你成为商人后，把低价买进技能练高些，就能用更便宜的价格买到想要的东西。

scripts.text: The practice of overcharge will be the same.
scripts.translation: 高价卖出也是同样的道理。

scripts.text: You don't need to practice the overcharge as well. You experience it while selling items earned during the other courses.
scripts.translation: 高价卖出不用特意练习。上其他课程时，把获得的物品卖掉就能体验了。

scripts.text: Now the Merchant training at the Academy is finished.
scripts.translation: 学院的商人训练到此结束。

scripts.text: Hahaha. {0} you have completed the Merchant theory course at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，{0}，你已经完成克里图拉学院的商人理论课程了。

scripts.text: When you want to test the other battle skills in the Merchant's Manual,
scripts.translation: 想体验商人手册里的其他战斗技能时，

scripts.text: visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation: 请去一楼拜访<NAVI>[战斗训练师 苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: You can fully experience the battle related practice through him.
scripts.translation: 你可以跟他充分练习战斗相关的内容。

scripts.text: The guide for the next course {0} will be serviced when you reach job level 10. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 达到职业等级10后，就能参加下一门课程{0}。祝你好运。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded.
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，无法继续任务。

scripts.text: Mr. Hamid sent you here. Nice to meet you. Being busy in organizing the account book, I will make time for you.
scripts.translation: 哈米德先生让你来找我吧？幸会。我正忙着整理账簿，不过还是能抽空接待你。

scripts.text: There are many ways to make margin on trading.. A threat, a concillation, black-market dealings, etc.
scripts.translation: 做生意赚钱的手段可多了...威胁、和解、黑市交易，等等。

scripts.text: If necessary, even various violent and bloody shortcuts (wow this guy is serious!)
scripts.translation: 必要时，还能走各种暴力血腥的捷径。（哇，这家伙还真敢说！）

scripts.text: OH wait, what did I tell you?
These are legally prohibited behaviors. So, Merchants will be given two skills. Those are ^4d4fffOvercharge and Discount^000000..
scripts.translation: 什么？这些手段都违法。所以商人有两项技能：高价卖出和低价买进。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: Besides, there are some other helpful skills such as ^4d4fffPush Cart Vending, Item Appraisal^000000 etc.. Which are not related directly to them though.
scripts.translation: 此外还有一些实用技能，比如手推车、露天商店和物品鉴定，不过它们和这两项技能没有直接关系。 ^4d4fff^000000
这些技能有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
Really are you OK with it?
Ho O~ You don't have any questions?
OK. You are a person of practice rather than of theory.
scripts.translation: 好吧，看来你是重实践、轻理论的人。

scripts.text: The additional lecture will be provided by Mr. Salim Hamid. Ah. I have something to give you.
scripts.translation: 接下来的课程由萨利姆·哈米德先生负责。对了，我有样东西要给你。

scripts.text: This is a box containing the defective equipments leaving from the inventory organization here.
scripts.translation: 这是整理库存时清出来的一箱瑕疵装备。用它来练

scripts.text: Please practice the Item Appraisal skill in the Merchant Manual with it.
scripts.translation: 习商人入门手册里的物品鉴定技能吧。

scripts.text: I anticipate to see you next time in a good shape.
scripts.translation: 希望下次见面时，你已经练得身手矫健。

scripts.text: Ho O~ Sorry but I got you wrong.
It is simple to use Overcharge and Discount.
scripts.translation: 高价卖出和低价买进都很容易使用。

scripts.text: These two skills are passive skills. If you become familiar with these, {0} these will automatically perform in trading with merchant NPC without your operation.
scripts.translation: 这两项都是被动技能。熟悉之后，{0}在和商人 NPC 交易时会自动生效，无需手动操作。

scripts.text: Once you've learned Overcharge, when selling commodities to a merchant NPC, you can gain the sales money composed of the regular sales price plus additional money as per the Overcharge skill level.
scripts.translation: 学会高价卖出后，把商品卖给商人 NPC 时，除了正常售价，还能根据技能等级获得额外收入。

scripts.text: Oppositely, Discount is the skill, on your buying commodities from a merchant NPC, you can purchase it at the price discounted on the regular selling price as per the skill level.
scripts.translation: 低价买进则相反：从商人 NPC 购买商品时，可以根据技能等级享受折扣。

scripts.text: Be carefult that these two skills are to be used only in trading with usual merchant's NPC, not with other manufacturing NPC or among adventurers.
scripts.translation: 要注意，这两项技能只对普通商人 NPC 的交易有效，不能用于其他制造类 NPC，也不能用于冒险者之间的交易。

scripts.text: Enlarge Weight Limit, Push Cart, Vending. These three skills have close relationships.
scripts.translation: 负重量上升、手推车和露天商店这三项技能彼此密切相关。

scripts.text: First talking about ^4d4fffEnlarge Weight Limit^000000 skill, is the skill to increase th character's basic earned points. It is an automatic operational passive skill when you learn it.
scripts.translation: 先说说负重量上升。这个技能可以提高角色的负重上限，学会后会自动生效。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.text: This earned point skill reaching a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffPush Cart^000000
scripts.translation: 负重量上升达到一定等级后，就能使用手推车技能。 ^4d4fff^000000

scripts.translation: 总之，员工就该照老板的意思办事...有什么问题就问我吧。

scripts.text: Perhaps the most important thing my owner thinks is this...
scripts.translation: 老板最看重的，大概就是这一点...

scripts.text: From the word itself, refining price is ^3E86C3the charge to refine once^000000.
scripts.translation: 顾名思义，精炼费用就是每次精炼所需的费用。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: But, there are ^3E86C3differences in the essential material according the zeny and weapon level.^000000.
scripts.translation: 不过，所需的材料和Zeny会因武器等级而异。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: Refining of level 1 weapons requires ^3E86C3Phracon and 1000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation: 精炼1级武器需要强化武器金属-级数一和1,000 Zeny。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: As Phracon is the most popular metal, you can get it from monsters but also from Tadde at 200 zeny.
scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数一是最常见的金属，既可以从魔物身上获得，也可以在塔德那里花200 Zeny购买。

scripts.text: Refining level 2 weapons requires ^3E86C3Emveretarcon and 2,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation: 精炼2级武器需要强化武器金属-级数二和2,000 Zeny。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: Emveretarcon is also a relatively popular metal. You can get it either from monsters or from Tadde at 1000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数二也比较常见，既可以从魔物身上获得，也可以在塔德那里花1,000 Zeny购买。

scripts.text: Refining of level 3 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 10,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation: 精炼3级武器需要神之金属和10,000 Zeny。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: Oridecon is such a rare metal that I don't sell it... But,
scripts.translation: 神之金属非常稀有，所以我这里不卖...不过，

scripts.text: If you have 5 Rough Oridecon obtainable from some monsters, you can refine them to make one Oridecon.
scripts.translation: 有些魔物会掉落神之金属原石。收集5个交给我，我就能把它们精炼成1个神之金属。

scripts.text: Refining level 4 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 20,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation: 精炼4级武器需要神之金属和20,000 Zeny。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation: 铝和神之金属一样稀有。和神之金属一样，有些魔物会掉落铝原石。带5个来，我就能帮你精炼成1个铝。

scripts.text: Refining the Armor requires ^3E86C3Elunium and 20000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation: 精炼防具需要铝和20,000 Zeny。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation: 铝和神之金属一样稀有。和神之金属一样，有些魔物会掉落铝原石。带5个来，我就能帮你精炼成1个铝。

scripts.text: You look like you've had enough explanations about the refining prices.
scripts.translation: 看来您已经了解精炼费用了。

scripts.text: I think you are now knowledgeable enough about refining.
scripts.translation: 我想您现在已经充分了解精炼了。

scripts.text: Now I will explain to you about ^3E86C3the effect of refining^000000.
scripts.translation: 现在我来为您说明精炼的效果。 ^3E86C3^000000

scripts.text: This time I won't give you explanations about individual items. It is better you do the physical experiences by yourself instead of verbal explanations.
scripts.translation: 这次我就不逐项说明了。与其听我讲，不如你亲自体验一番。

scripts.text: Anyway, here are the explanations. From level 1 weapon,
scripts.translation: 总之，我来说明一下。先从1级武器说起。

scripts.text: 1 level weapon has ^A20B09the attacking power increased 2^000000 by each +1 refining. Do you understand?
scripts.translation: 1级武器每精炼+1，攻击力就会增加2点。明白了吗？ ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: I thought my explanations to you were easy, but it wasn't...
scripts.translation: 我还以为解释得够简单了...看来并没有。

scripts.text: So, if you refine a knife with 17 attacking power and by +1, it will become 19 attacking power.. Like this.
scripts.translation: 比如，攻击力为17的短剑精炼+1后，攻击力就会变成19。就是这么回事。

scripts.text: In fact, there is no need to talk too much here. You just experience it later.
scripts.translation: 其实没必要解释太多，之后你亲自试试就明白了。

scripts.text: Level 2 weapon will add ^A20B093^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation: 2级武器每精炼+1，攻击力就会增加3点。 ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: Level 3 weapon will add ^A20B095^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation: 3级武器每精炼+1，攻击力就会增加5点。 ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: Lastly, level 4 weapon will add ^A20B097^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation: 最后，4级武器每精炼+1，攻击力就会增加7点。 ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: Ah, I missed the Armor. The Armor can be add ^A20B091^000000 to the defense power per each refining level.
scripts.translation: 啊，差点忘了防具。防具每精炼+1，防御力就会增加1点。 ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: Well, by now the explanations were only for the effect of the safe refining....
scripts.translation: 好了，刚才说明的都只是安全精炼的效果...

scripts.text: You would better learn yourself ^A20B09the effect of over refining^000000 regardless of potential risk.
scripts.translation: 不妨亲自了解一下超过安全上限精炼的效果，不过要自行承担风险。 ^A20B09^000000

scripts.text: If I tell you all the details, it is likely you start reading an epic novel of 10,000 pages, I'll tell you the ending of it.
scripts.translation: 要是把所有细节都告诉你，恐怕得讲上一万页。我还是直接告诉你结论吧。

scripts.text: One thing to be clear is you should be careful about destroying your equipment if you get over-eager.
scripts.translation: 有一点要记住：精炼过头的话，装备可能会损坏，一定要小心。

scripts.text: Seems like, you don't have any further questions. Thank you for listening to a long story.
scripts.translation: 看来你没有其他问题了。谢谢你听我讲了这么久。

scripts.text: You can say anything to my owner. The performance rating doesn't mean much to our technicians.
scripts.translation: 你尽管把情况告诉老板。对我们技术人员来说，绩效考核没那么重要。

scripts.text: If you bring me 5 Rough Oridecon or Elunium, I will immediately make them to Oridecon or Elunium.
scripts.translation: 带来5个神之金属原石或铝原石，我就能马上把它们精炼成神之金属或铝。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品栏中物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Welcome. Welcome to the enchant association. I am ^142CEBMounds^000000- head of Izlude branch of the Enchant association.
scripts.translation: 欢迎，欢迎来到附魔协会。我是蒙兹，附魔协会依斯鲁得岛分部的负责人。 ^142CEB^000000

scripts.text: Have you never seen a talking cat?
scripts.translation: 您没见过会说话的猫吗？

scripts.text: There is an island called ^FD4F02Malangdo^000000 where only cats live and I am from there.
scripts.translation: 有座名叫绵绵岛的岛，岛上住的全是猫。我就来自那里。 ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: There are cats like me who can speak the human language very well, but some cats speaking human and cat language are a mess.
scripts.translation: 像我这样能流利说人类语言的猫并不少见，不过有些猫说起话来会把人类语和猫语混在一起，听着乱七八糟的。

scripts.text: Well, that can be checked in Malangdo later are you interested in ^FD4F02Enchantments^000000?
scripts.translation: 这些事以后到了绵绵岛再说吧。您对附魔感兴趣吗？ ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: The Enchant Association is the group made by those of us who can enchant.
scripts.translation: 附魔协会是由我们这些会附魔的人组成的组织。

scripts.text: This association is composed of two divisions of ^FD4F02the socket enchant division^000000 and ^FD4F02the hidden enchant division^000000.
scripts.translation: 协会分为两个部门：插槽附魔部和隐藏附魔部。 ^FD4F02^000000^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: Maybe, are you curious about each division?
scripts.translation: 您对这两个部门感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: You are curious about the socket enchant.. Here is the explantion.
scripts.translation: 您对插槽附魔很感兴趣啊...那我来说明一下。

scripts.text: From unknown reason, There has been existing ^FD4F02card slots^000000 on the equipments obtainable from monsters.
scripts.translation: 不知为何，从魔物身上获得的装备上一直都有卡片插槽。 ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: People started to question, 'Can we make a device to insert cards to these?'
scripts.translation: 于是人们开始琢磨：“能不能制造一种装置，把卡片装进这些插槽里呢？”

scripts.text: At last, one day a man called ^142CEBSeyablem^000000 showed up with the technology of socket enchant.
scripts.translation: 终于有一天，一位名叫塞亚布勒姆的人带来了插槽附魔技术。 ^142CEB^000000

scripts.text: Nobody knew how he got the technology....
scripts.translation: 没人知道他是怎么掌握这项技术的...

scripts.text: Someday later, a younger brother of Seyablem called ^142CEBLeyablem^000000 introduced a different device from his brother to socket enchant other equipments.
scripts.translation: 后来，塞亚布勒姆的弟弟雷亚布勒姆也出现了。他带来一种不同于哥哥的装置，可以为其他装备进行插槽附魔。 ^142CEB^000000

scripts.text: Many people using the brothers' socket enchanting services, they stole the technology
scripts.translation: 许多人使用兄弟俩的插槽附魔服务后，竟然偷走了这项技术。

scripts.text: The brothers happened to join the enchant association. And from time to time, they teach the technology to us in Malangdo.
scripts.translation: 兄弟俩后来加入了附魔协会。他们偶尔会把这项技术传授给绵绵岛上的我们。

scripts.text: Learning the technology diligently, some day will come when others can do socket enchants.
scripts.translation: 只要认真学习这项技术，总有一天其他人也能进行插槽附魔。

scripts.text: Ah, my story went off topic.
Well, conclusion is this, socket enchant means to add a card socket to the common equipment being sold at any shops.
scripts.translation: 简单来说，插槽附魔就是给商店出售的普通装备添加卡片插槽。

scripts.text: It is called socket enchant. Are you curious about the other division?
scripts.translation: 这就是插槽附魔。您还想了解另一个部门吗？[蒙兹]看来您没有其他问题了。

scripts.text: Ah ! Are you curious about the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation: 啊！您想了解隐藏附魔吗？

scripts.text: OK. First, I have to let you know how the hidden enchnat skill was born.
scripts.translation: 好。首先，我得告诉您隐藏附魔技术是如何诞生的。

scripts.text: The original inventor was looking for a way to unlock the 4th slot of a 3 slotted weapon.
scripts.translation: 最初的发明者一直在寻找解锁三插槽武器第4个插槽的方法。

scripts.text: So he studied the technology to make use of the remaining slot.
scripts.translation: 于是，他开始研究如何利用剩余插槽。

scripts.text: When the study was finally successful he taught it to his apprentices and was never heard from again.
scripts.translation: 研究终于成功后，他把这项技术传授给徒弟，之后便再也没有消息了。

scripts.text: His technology reinforced the equipment with a gem that had special properties similar to monster cards.
scripts.translation: 他发明的技术可以用宝石强化装备，而宝石具有类似魔物卡片的特殊属性。

scripts.text: That technology has been developed and improved to make the current ^FD4F02Enchant association ^000000
scripts.translation: 这项技术不断发展改进，最终形成了现在的附魔协会。 ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: Briefly speaking, to make a stronger equipment with a special enchantment is the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation: 简单来说，隐藏附魔就是通过特殊附魔来打造更强大的装备。

scripts.text: Are you curious about the other division?
scripts.translation: 您还想了解另一个部门吗？[蒙兹]看来您没有其他问题了。

scripts.text: You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation: 看来您没有其他问题了。

scripts.text: Later, if you want to experience the hidden enchant or socket enchant, I will give you a hand.
scripts.translation: 以后想体验隐藏附魔或插槽附魔的话，我可以帮您。

scripts.text: Welcome.. Ah, we've met before right?
scripts.translation: 欢迎...啊，我们以前见过吧？

scripts.text: Are you coming to experience the hidden enchant or the socket enchant?
scripts.translation: 您是来体验隐藏附魔，还是插槽附魔？

scripts.text: You may be on the way to Prontera. Be careful and come back.
scripts.translation: 您是要去普隆德拉吧？路上小心，记得再来。

scripts.text: The experience course starts from the experience of the simple socket enchant.
scripts.translation: 体验课程会从简单的插槽附魔开始。

scripts.text: For this, you need material. Will you buy a cotton shirt at Izlude Armor shop?
scripts.translation: 体验需要用到材料。您愿意去依斯鲁得岛的防具店买一件棉衬衫吗？

scripts.text: When you bring the cotton shirt, we will immediately start ^FD4F02the socket enchnat experience^000000 course.
scripts.translation: 带来棉衬衫后，我们就马上开始插槽附魔体验课程。 ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: Oh this is a socketed shirt already!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这件衬衫已经有插槽了！

scripts.text: Bring us the normal shirt without holes.
scripts.translation: 请带一件没有插槽的普通衬衫来。

scripts.text: It must be a plain cotton shirt.
scripts.translation: 需要一件普通的棉衬衫。

scripts.text: When you bring the plain cotton shirt from the Armor shop, we will start the socket enchant experience.
scripts.translation: 从防具店买一件普通的棉衬衫带来，我们就开始插槽附魔体验。

scripts.text: Not like all other enchants, the socket enchant is being worked without items installed.
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔和其他附魔不同，不需要先在装备上镶嵌物品。

scripts.text: Then, let's start the socket enchant.
scripts.translation: 那么，我们开始插槽附魔吧。

scripts.text: You have suceeded in socket enchant.
Have you checked the equipment? It now has an empty slot in it.
scripts.translation: 检查过装备了吗？现在上面多了一个空插槽。

scripts.text: But, like this time the success rate is not always ^FD4F02100%^000000 as you are still in the studying phase.
scripts.translation: 不过，像这次这样，成功率并不总是100%。毕竟我们还在学习阶段。 ^FD4F02^000000

scripts.text: Please keep in mind that there always risks of failure and if failed, the equipment will be broken.
scripts.translation: 请记住，附魔总有失败的风险。一旦失败，装备就会损坏。

scripts.text: If you want to know more about the socket enchant, go and consult with Leyablem or Seyablem who are working at Prontera or Payon.
scripts.translation: 想进一步了解插槽附魔的话，可以去普隆德拉或斐扬，向在那里工作的雷亚布勒姆或塞亚布勒姆请教。

scripts.text: Now it's time for your experiencing the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation: 现在该体验隐藏附魔了。

scripts.text: Equipped with the just socket enchanted cotton shirt, get the hidden enchant from
scripts.translation: 穿上刚才完成插槽附魔的棉衬衫，去找那边负责隐藏附魔的猫阿尔蒙德 J。

scripts.text: Almond J, the cat in charge with the hidden enchant over there.
scripts.translation: 阿尔蒙德 J 就在那边，是负责隐藏附魔的猫。

scripts.text: Get the hidden enchant from Almond J with wearing the cotton shirt socket enchanted.
scripts.translation: 穿着完成插槽附魔的棉衬衫，去找阿尔蒙德 J 进行隐藏附魔。

scripts.text: Eh? You came earlier than expected? I though it might take time after listening to all the explanations.
scripts.translation: 咦？你来得比预想中早啊。我还以为听完所有说明后，你要花些时间才会回来。

scripts.text: I should beware of you, when you were making a big noise to do the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation: 你当时嚷着要做隐藏附魔，我就该提防着你。

scripts.text: Anyway, I am sorry.. Though it is short, I will make the explanation for you.
scripts.translation: 总之，很抱歉...虽然时间不多，我还是简单说明一下。

scripts.text: Have you checked the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation: 你检查过隐藏附魔了吗？

scripts.text: As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation: 既然你已经检查过了，我就好说明多了。

scripts.text: Hmmm. Recommend you examine the condition of your cotton shirt, opening item window.
scripts.translation: 嗯。建议你打开物品栏，检查一下棉衬衫的状态。

scripts.text: As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation: 既然你已经检查过了，我就好说明多了。

scripts.text: As I explained you just before, the hidden enchant is the work to insert to weapoon or Armor a gem with a special option into the equipment.
scripts.translation: 正如刚才所说，隐藏附魔就是把带有特殊效果的宝石附加到武器或防具上。

scripts.text: As you know it, if you checked, you may notice something new was at the no. 3 and 4 slots at the bottom of item information window.
scripts.translation: 检查之后，你应该会发现物品信息窗口底部的第3和第4个插槽有了变化。

scripts.text: Hidden enchant is being proceeded with the similar equipment worn as Almond J's.
scripts.translation: 隐藏附魔的操作方式和阿尔蒙德 J 那边类似。

scripts.text: Of course, there are some other places to do the hidden enchants.
scripts.translation: 当然，也有其他地方可以进行隐藏附魔。

scripts.text: It is fortunate. Do you have any experience to be added? If so, please write it to me.
scripts.translation: 那太好了。您还有什么体验感受想补充吗？有的话请告诉我。

scripts.text: Experience seems not be satisfactory with you. Can you write me what was it?
scripts.translation: 看来这次体验不太符合您的期待。能告诉我具体哪里不满意吗？

scripts.text: I will refer it for planning the next experience.
scripts.translation: 我会参考您的意见，安排下一次体验。

scripts.text: Thank you for your valuable advice.
Thank you for your patience listening to my boring explanation.
scripts.translation: 感谢您耐心听完我这些无聊的说明。

scripts.text: This is a small gift hoping your continuous support for our enchant association.
scripts.translation: 这是一份小礼物，希望您今后继续支持附魔协会。

scripts.text: Received the explanation about the enchants, some experience and Kafra storage free coupon.
scripts.translation: 已收到附魔说明、一些经验值和卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Received the explanation and Kafra free storage coupon.
scripts.translation: 已收到说明和卡普拉仓库免费利用券。

scripts.text: Then, I will see you later.
Welcome to the enchant association. I am Mounds - head of Izlude branch of Enchant association.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到附魔协会。我是蒙兹，附魔协会依斯鲁得岛分部的负责人。

scripts.text: Eh? Your appreance is familiar. Have we met before?
scripts.translation: 咦？您看起来很眼熟。我们以前见过吗？

scripts.text: As I can't remember all the people I met as they are too many, strangely you have a face not to forget.
scripts.translation: 我见过的人太多，记不住所有人。不过，不知为何，您的脸让我过目难忘。

scripts.text: Perhaps, are you here to learn about enchanting? I will kindly explain you about it.
scripts.translation: 您是来了解附魔的吗？我很乐意为您说明。

scripts.text: Socket enchant is the skill to make card slots appear in Weapon or Armor.
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔可以为武器或防具添加卡片插槽。

scripts.text: When you meet the Seyablem and Leyablem brothers around the towns of Rune-Midgarts they can help you with this service.
scripts.translation: 在卢恩·米德加兹各城镇遇到塞亚布勒姆和雷亚布勒姆兄弟的话，他们可以为您提供这项服务。

scripts.text: If they fail to put a new slot in your item say farewell to it...
scripts.translation: 如果添加插槽失败，装备就会损坏...到时只能和它说再见了。

scripts.text: It's usually a good idea to have more than 1 item to add a slot to because it can fail a lot sometimes.
scripts.translation: 最好多准备几件要添加插槽的装备，因为有时失败率很高。

scripts.text: Hidden enchant means to put enchanted gems into the hidden slots of an item.
scripts.translation: 隐藏附魔就是将附魔宝石镶嵌到物品的隐藏插槽中。

scripts.text: You have to be wearing the item that is being enchanted as it uses the wearers fortune as the success rate.
scripts.translation: 进行隐藏附魔时，必须穿着要附魔的装备，因为成功率取决于穿戴者的幸运。

scripts.text: Many places are providing the various hidden enchant service in different ways, if you have time, please visit one of them.
scripts.translation: 许多地方都提供各式各样的隐藏附魔服务，有空的话请去看看。

scripts.text: News? Enchant association doesn't have a big issue going on.
scripts.translation: 新闻？附魔协会最近没发生什么大事。

scripts.text: Ah!! I remember that Almond J sent with me from Izlude branch wanted to do advertising...
scripts.translation: 啊！我想起来了，阿尔蒙德 J 之前派人从依斯鲁得岛分部过来，说想做宣传...

scripts.text: He drafted the initiative for the free service of hidden enchant to the beginner's weapons. I approved it as it looked a good idea.
scripts.translation: 他提议为新手武器提供免费隐藏附魔服务。我觉得不错，就批准了。

scripts.text: What? If you have a beginners weapon, it may not hurt to try it.
scripts.translation: 什么？如果你有新手武器，不妨来试试。

scripts.text: Come to me whenever you have a question about the enchant association.
scripts.translation: 对附魔协会有疑问的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text: Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation: 好像出了什么问题。如果一直这样，请联系客服。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品栏中物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Hello, I am Almon J of the enchant association.~
scripts.translation: 你好，我是附魔协会的阿尔蒙德 J。~

scripts.text: If you have anything to do with the enchant association, please consult with Mounds inside.
scripts.translation: 如果有附魔协会相关的事情，请进来找蒙兹商量。

scripts.text: Welcome.. I have been waiting for you. Are you coming for the hidden enchant service on your cotton shirt?
scripts.translation: 欢迎...我一直在等您。您是来为棉衬衫进行隐藏附魔的吗？

scripts.text: Has your ^142cebCotton Shirt[1]^000000 been equipped? Shall we start now? Ready?
scripts.translation: 您装备好棉衬衫[1]了吗？现在开始吗？准备好了吗？ ^142ceb^000000

scripts.text: Heh... is that so? Frankly, it is my first time... I am really excited.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿...是吗？说实话，这是我第一次...我真的很兴奋。

scripts.text: Are you ready? Yes? Do it now. Now!!
scripts.translation: 准备好了吗？准备好了？那现在就开始吧！马上！！

scripts.text: Heh? Eh? Hik?! Come here quick.
Please come back after you have equipped the Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation: 请装备好棉衬衫后再回来。

scripts.text: Hing, it is not a normal Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这可不是普通的棉衬衫。

scripts.text: Now!! Start the first hidden enchant!! Start!!!!!
scripts.translation: 现在！！开始第一次隐藏附魔！！开始！！！！

scripts.text: How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation: 怎么样？隐藏附魔很棒吧？还想再做一次吗？

scripts.text: It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation: 真好玩，我还想再来一次。喂，再试一次好吗？啊啊啊！！我还想做隐藏附魔！

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你已经渐渐沉浸在自己的世界里了。还是回蒙兹那里去吧。

scripts.text: How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation: 怎么样？隐藏附魔很棒吧？还想再做一次吗？

scripts.text: It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation: 真好玩，我还想再来一次。喂，再试一次好吗？啊啊啊！！我还想做隐藏附魔！

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你已经渐渐沉浸在自己的世界里了。还是回蒙兹那里去吧。

scripts.text: Heh heh... how are you? I am doing a ^142CEBservice of free hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon to advertise the enchant association.^000000.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿...最近怎么样？我正在为新手武器提供免费隐藏附魔服务，借此宣传附魔协会。 ^142CEB^000000

scripts.text: Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation: 好像出了什么问题。如果一直这样，请联系客服。

scripts.text: As you are still a beginner, you don't have a very, very, very functional jewelry, but soon you will have.
scripts.translation: 你还是个新手，还没有特别特别特别厉害的饰品，不过很快就会有了。

scripts.text: How about it? Will you try the hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon free of charge?
scripts.translation: 怎么样？要免费体验一次新手武器的隐藏附魔吗？

scripts.text: Ah!! Weapons? Hehehe.. I didn't explain it to you enough.
scripts.translation: 啊！！武器？嘿嘿...我还没跟你解释清楚呢。

scripts.text: The weapon to be serviced with the free hidden enchant has the ^FD4F02Novice^000000 name in front of the weapon.
scripts.translation: 可以免费进行隐藏附魔的武器，名称前会带有“初心者”字样。 ^FD4F02^000000
器：短剑、钝器、手杖、斧头等。

scripts.text: Where are you going? You should do the hidden enchant before going.
scripts.translation: ！！！你要去哪儿？应该先做完隐藏附魔再走啊。

scripts.text: Hehehe... hidden enchant makes me excited. But you should come back with your weapon armed.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿...隐藏附魔让我好兴奋。不过，你得带着武器回来才行。

scripts.text: But this weapon might be strange to add a hidden enchant? Sorry.
scripts.translation: 不过，这把武器好像不适合进行隐藏附魔？抱歉。

scripts.text: Ehee.. It is not a Novice Weapon. Leaving this expensive weapon to us and if broken... I'm not taking that chance.
scripts.translation: 呃...这不是初心者武器。把这么贵的武器交给我们，万一弄坏了...我可担不起这个责任。

scripts.text: It is a good weapon Then!! Let's start the hidden enchant!!
scripts.translation: 这把武器不错！那么！！开始隐藏附魔！！

scripts.text: As I'm too excited, I can't check the options. Please check it yourself.
scripts.translation: 了！！我太兴奋了，没检查附加效果。请您自己确认一下。

scripts.text: Repairing broken equipment!! If you have broken equipment, bring it to me anytime.
scripts.translation: 装备损坏了就来修理！有坏掉的装备，随时拿来找我。
现在没有需要修理的装备。

scripts.text: You must treat your equipment carefully... as you don't have anything to be repaired.
scripts.translation: 您没有需要修理的装备...平时可要好好爱惜装备啊。

scripts.text: Would you like to proceed with the repair?
Well, I don't care. After all, it's not my equipment. However, leaving equipment unchecked is not a wise choice.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我无所谓，反正这又不是我的装备。不过，放着装备不管可不明智。

scripts.text: The repair cost is 5000 Zeny per damaged equipment. You do not have enough money.
scripts.translation: 每件破损装备的修理费是5,000 Zeny。您的钱不够。

scripts.text: The repair has been completed. Be sure to take good care of your equipment.
scripts.translation: 修理完成了。记得好好爱惜装备。

scripts.text: If you don't have any equipment to be repaired, you may not have something to talk with me about.
scripts.translation: 如果没有需要修理的装备，您应该也没什么事要找我。

scripts.text: A specific skill or boss monster could break your equipment frequently.
scripts.translation: 某些特定技能或头目魔物可能会频繁损坏您的装备。

scripts.text: This doesn't mean that your equipment is gone forever like what happens during refining.
scripts.translation: 这和精炼时装备损坏不同，您的装备不会就此消失。

scripts.text: When your item breaks this way, they won't perform normally...
scripts.translation: 装备这样损坏后，就无法正常使用了...

scripts.text: In this case, bring it to me, and I will repair it back to new at the cost of 5000 zeny for each equipment.
scripts.translation: 遇到这种情况，把装备拿来找我吧。我可以帮您修复如新，每件收费5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: The training grounds have been revised.
I will send you to Izlude.
